title: Follow the Winners: Conservative Policy Improvement with the Cross-Entropy Method for Critic-Free RFT
title_zh: Follow the Winners:保守政策改进的交叉熵方法用于无评价器的RFT

paragraphs.en: Critic-free reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) for agentic large language models is often done through GRPO-style methods, which compute a group baseline over repeated rollouts to reduce target variance. However, this setup is ill-suited to agents acting in stateful environments such as live services or security sandboxes, where repeated rollouts are impractical to obtain and aggressive updates entrench the noise of long, sparsely verified trajectories. We propose Follow the Winners (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that adapts the cross-entropy method to RFT, replacing group rollouts with an ordinal filter on replay-buffer samples that yields polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns. We derive FTW through a control-as-inference lens, which also recovers GRPO and DPO as specific modelling choices, identifying GRPO as risk-neutral while DPO and FTW share a bounded risk-seeking offset that FTW controls. We identify this offset as an inherent trade-off of variance reduction through ordinal filters on samples, whereas a critic model induces a different trade-off between bias and variance. Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and Search-R1 baselines, showing a viable trade-off from a value model or group rollouts to CPU memory.
paragraphs.zh: 针对智能体式大型语言模型的无批评者强化微调（RFT）通常通过 GRPO 风格的方法实现，这些方法通过对重复展开计算群体基线来降低目标方差。 然而，这种设置并不适合在具有状态记忆的环境中运行的智能体，例如实时服务或安全沙箱，因为在这种情况下获取重复展开是不切实际的，而激进的更新会固化来自漫长且验证稀疏的轨迹中的噪声。 我们提出了“跟随获胜者”（FTW）算法，这是一种无批评者的策略学习算法，它将交叉熵方法适配到 RFT 中，用重播缓冲区样本上的序数过滤器取代群体展开，从而在回报的序统计量上实现多项式集中。 我们通过“控制即推理”的视角推导出了 FTW，这一视角也将 GRPO 和 DPO 恢复为特定的建模选择：GRPO 是风险中立的，而 DPO 和 FTW 共享一个有界的风险寻求偏移量，且 FTW 能够控制该偏移量。 我们将这种偏移量视为通过样本上的序数过滤器降低方差所固有的权衡，而批评者模型则会引入偏差与方差之间的不同权衡。 在智能体式 LLM 的后续训练中进行扩展后，FTW 在 Sokoban 和 Search-R1 基线测试中与 GRPO 和 PPO 表现相当，展示了从价值模型或群体展开转向 CPU 内存的一种可行权衡。

paragraphs.en: Agentic large language models (LLMs) are increasingly post-trained with reinforcement learning fine-tuning (RFT) to act on software systems ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2025b ) , where tasks range from writing or repairing code ( Wei et al., 2025b ) , to investigating security incidents through logs and configurations ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Roy et al., 2024 ) , to discovering, reproducing, and autonomously patching security vulnerabilities ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . But, when an agent trajectory spans many tool calls and reasoning chains, reproducibility and variance become increasingly problematic due to sparse verifiable outcomes, partial observability, or context compression. Even under deterministic rewards, the resulting trajectory returns exhibit high variance due to long horizons, partial observability, and state aliasing ( Kaelbling et al., 1998 ; Spaan, 2012 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2023 ) . Policy-gradient methods such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) partly reduce variance with a learned critic, at the cost of GPU memory for a second model and possible bias depending on how we bootstrap ( Schulman et al., 2016 ) . Critic-free methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) instead compute a baseline from a group of repeated rollouts per prompt, which moves the cost to throughput and requires every rollout in the group to have identical initial states. This assumption is fine for static code-writing, but is unrealistic in live or production systems where agents operate in stateful sandboxes. Moreover, despite these variance-reduction methods, most policy gradient methods still concentrate aggressively on absolute returns ( Mei et al., 2020a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地通过强化学习微调（RFT）进行后训练，以在软件系统中执行操作（Zhang 等人，2026；Wei 等人，2025b），其任务范围涵盖编写或修复代码（Wei 等人，2025b）、通过日志和配置调查安全事件（Wang 等人，2024；Roy 等人，2024），到发现、复现并自主修补安全漏洞（Zhang 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2025；Wang 等人，2025a）。 然而，当智能体的轨迹涉及大量工具调用和推理链时，由于可验证结果稀疏、部分可观测性或上下文压缩，可复现性和方差问题会变得越来越严重。 即使在确定性奖励下，由于时间步长较长、部分可观测性和状态别名问题，最终得到的轨迹回报仍表现出高方差（Kaelbling 等人，1998；Spaan，2012；Ouyang 等人，2022；Yao 等人，2023）。 PPO（Schulman 等人，2017）等策略梯度方法借助学习到的批评者部分降低了方差，但代价是需为第二个模型分配 GPU 内存，并可能因启动方式不同而产生偏差（Schulman 等人，2016）。 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）等无需批评者的方法则通过每个提示词下重复执行的多个 rollout 计算基线，这将成本转移到了吞吐量上，并要求该组中的每个 rollout 都具有完全相同的状态初始值。 这一假设在静态代码编写中尚可接受，但在智能体运行于有状态沙盒的实时或生产系统中却并不现实。 此外，尽管存在这些方差降低方法，大多数策略梯度方法仍然过度集中于绝对回报（Mei 等人，2020a）。

paragraphs.en: These costs compound when trajectories are expensive to collect, comparable rollouts are difficult to obtain, and returns depend on sparse or approximate verification. For instance, in a security workflow, an attack-chain investigation may yield a single useful trajectory whose initial sandbox state is costly or impractical to reconstruct to gather more data. Likewise, a long-horizon inspection of logs to locate a bug or vulnerability can drift, hallucinate, or reason incorrectly, so that two trajectories on similar incidents yield different returns. Such data and post-training considerations suggest that a practical critic-free RFT algorithm should update conservatively to reduce noise entrenchment while drawing variance reduction from sources without GRPO’s or PPO’s stringent constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 当轨迹的收集成本高昂、难以获得可比较的执行过程，且回报依赖于稀疏或近似的验证时，这些成本会累积叠加。 例如，在安全工作流程中，攻击链调查可能仅产生一条有用的轨迹，而重建其初始沙盒状态以收集更多数据可能成本高昂或不切实际。 同样地，为定位错误或漏洞而对日志进行长期检查时，推理过程可能会偏离、产生幻觉或出现错误，导致两条针对相似事件的轨迹产生不同的回报。 此类数据和训练后考量表明，一种实用的无批评者 RFT 算法应以保守方式更新，以减少噪声固化，同时从无需 GRPO 或 PPO 严格约束的来源中获取方差缩减效果。

paragraphs.en: We propose Follow the Winners (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that induces polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns. This behavior stems from our trajectory filtering procedure, which adapts the cross-entropy method ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; Rubinstein, 1999 ; Botev et al., 2013 ) to deep RL through minibatched filtering over a replay-buffer proposal that amortizes data generation and serves as the alternative source of variance reduction. We show that the well-known post-training algorithm DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) and FTW share a bounded risk-seeking offset, which we identify as inherent to reducing variance through ordinal filters on samples. Furthermore, we show that GRPO is risk-neutral and that FTW controls its risk offset through its selection pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“跟随赢家”（Follow the Winners，FTW）算法，这是一种无需评论家的策略学习算法，能够促使回报的序统计量呈现多项式收敛。 这种行为源于我们的轨迹过滤流程：该流程将交叉熵方法（Rubinstein, 1997；Rubinstein, 1999；Botev 等，2013）通过基于重播缓冲区提议的小批量过滤方式适配到深度强化学习中，从而摊销数据生成成本，并作为另一种方差削减的来源。 我们证明了广为人知的训练后算法 DPO（Rafailov 等，2023）与 FTW 共享一个有界的风险偏好偏移量，而这一偏移量源于通过样本的序统计量过滤器来降低方差。 此外，我们还证明了 GRPO 是风险中立的，而 FTW 则通过其选择压力来控制其风险偏移量。

sents.en: We propose Follow the Winners (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm that induces polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns.

sents.zh: 此外，我们还证明了 GRPO 是风险中立的，而 FTW 则通过其选择压力来控制其风险偏移量。

paragraphs.en: Our analysis is grounded in the Control-as-Inference (CAI) framework ( Ziebart, 2010 ; Levine, 2018 ; Kappen et al., 2012 ) , which we extend by recasting critic-free RFT as inference over potentials defined on trajectory batches rather than individual trajectories. The resulting variational objective motivates the cross-entropy method as a simple sampling-and-projection scheme for optimization, from which we derive FTW. Under the same view, DPO emerges as the pairwise special case of a Plackett–Luce potential ( Luce, 1959 ; Plackett, 1975 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , while GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) optimizes a Rao–Blackwellized upper bound on the evidence of a multinomial potential. This places GRPO, DPO, and FTW in a shared design space in which we can juxtapose their modelling decisions and risk offsets, a second theoretical axis of trade-offs next to the practical considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析基于“控制即推理”（Control-as-Inference，CAI）框架（Ziebart, 2010；Levine, 2018；Kappen et al., 2012），我们通过将无批评者的RFT重新表述为对轨迹批次上定义的概率势的推理（而非针对单个轨迹的推理），对该框架进行了扩展。 由此得到的变分目标促使我们将交叉熵方法视为一种简单的采样与投影优化方案，并据此推导出FTW。 在同一视角下，DPO可被视为Plackett–Luce势（Luce, 1959；Plackett, 1975；Rafailov et al., 2023）的一对特殊情形，而GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）则优化了多项分布势的证据的Rao–Blackwell化上界。 这使得GRPO、DPO和FTW处于一个共同的设计空间中，我们可以在其中对比它们的建模决策和风险权衡，从而在实践考量之外，形成第二个理论上的权衡维度。

paragraphs.en: We validate our theory predictions on diagnostic bandit problems and show that FTW extends as a general policy learning method in Brax continuous-control. Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW trains more stably and with lower seed variance than REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and the published Search-R1 baselines but with our alternative variance-reduction scheme, i.e., no value model, group rollouts or environment duplication. The LLM results show that the combined effect of FTW’s polynomially concentrating learning rule and replay-buffer proposal is a viable alternative to critics or group rollouts for counteracting variance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在诊断性多臂老虎机问题上验证了理论预测，并证明了 FTW 可作为 Brax 连续控制领域的一种通用策略学习方法。 在扩展到智能体 LLM 后训练阶段时，FTW 比 REINFORCE++（Hu et al., 2025）训练更稳定且种子方差更低，并在 Sokoban 和已发布的 Search-R1 基线模型上表现与 GRPO 和 PPO 相当，但无需采用我们的替代方差降低方案，即不需要价值模型、群体展开或环境复制。 LLM 实验结果表明，FTW 的多项式集中学习规则与重播缓冲区提议的协同效应，为抵消方差问题提供了可行的替代方案，可取代批评者或群体展开方法。

sents.en: We validate our theory predictions on diagnostic bandit problems and show that FTW extends as a general policy learning method in Brax continuous-control.
sents.zh: 我们在诊断性多臂老虎机问题上验证了理论预测，并证明了 FTW 可作为 Brax 连续控制领域的一种通用策略学习方法。

sents.en: Scaled to agentic LLM post-training, FTW trains more stably and with lower seed variance than REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and the published Search-R1 baselines but with our alternative variance-reduction scheme, i.e., no value model, group rollouts or environment duplication.
sents.zh: 在扩展到智能体 LLM 后训练阶段时，FTW 比 REINFORCE++（Hu et al., 2025）训练更稳定且种子方差更低，并在 Sokoban 和已发布的 Search-R1 基线模型上表现与 GRPO 和 PPO 相当，但无需采用我们的替代方差降低方案，即不需要价值模型、群体展开或环境复制。

sents.en: The LLM results show that the combined effect of FTW’s polynomially concentrating learning rule and replay-buffer proposal is a viable alternative to critics or group rollouts for counteracting variance.
sents.zh: LLM 实验结果表明，FTW 的多项式集中学习规则与重播缓冲区提议的协同效应，为抵消方差问题提供了可行的替代方案，可取代批评者或群体展开方法。

paragraphs.en: A large language model (LLM) defines an autoregressive distribution over token sequences that typically uses an attention-based neural architecture ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . We write this as p θ ( X 1 : T ) = ∏ t = 1 T p θ ( X t ∣ X < t ) p_{\theta}(X_{1:T})=\prod_{t=1}^{T}p_{\theta}(X_{t}\mid X_{<t}) , where X < t = ( X 1 , … , X t − 1 ) X_{<t}=(X_{1},\dots,X_{t-1}) denotes the prefix of previously generated tokens, X t X_{t} denotes the next token, and θ \theta parameterizes the model. The parameters θ pre ∗ \theta^{*}_{\mathrm{pre}} are fitted through supervised pre-training. Given a dataset of example sequences 𝒟 = { x 1 : T ( i ) } i = 1 N \mathcal{D}=\{x_{1:T}^{(i)}\}_{i=1}^{N} , this corresponds to solving θ pre ∗ = arg max θ 𝔼 x 1 : T ∼ μ 𝒟 ln p θ ( X 1 : T = x 1 : T ) \theta^{*}_{\mathrm{pre}}=\arg\max_{\theta}\mathbb{E}_{x_{1:T}\sim\mu_{\mathcal{D}}}\ln p_{\theta}(X_{1:T}=x_{1:T}) . In practice, many additional techniques are used to stabilize and improve training, including positional encodings ( Su et al., 2024 ) , layer normalization ( Ba et al., 2016 ) , gradient clipping, and tokenization.

paragraphs.en: To solve Eq. ( 3 ), algorithms such as MPO ( Abdolmaleki et al., 2018 ) sample directly from Eq. ( 2 ) before projecting the resulting solution back onto a parametric model 1 1 1 This is orthogonal to the constrained optimization of the Lagrangian in MPO, and the fact that MPO iteratively updates the reference policy π θ \pi_{\theta} as part of an expectation-maximization loop ( Neal and Hinton, 1998 ) . . This reflects a broader bootstrap-and-project scheme: trajectories are drawn from the proposal p π θ ​ ( H T ) p_{\pi_{\theta}}(H_{T}) , reweighted by an unnormalized potential Φ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \Phi(\cdot) encoding the optimization direction, and the resulting Φ \Phi -tilted empirical distribution is projected back onto the parametric family of π θ \pi_{\theta} to define the next prior. A useful parallel can be drawn here to the cross-entropy method (CEM) for optimization ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; Rubinstein, 1999 ; Botev et al., 2013 ) , see Algorithm 1 . CEM similarly draws a batch { x i } i = 1 N ∼ q ψ t \{x_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}\sim q_{\psi_{t}} , scores each sample by S ⁡ ( x i ) S(x_{i}) , and iteratively concentrates q ψ t q_{\psi_{t}} on high-scoring x i x_{i} in order to approach arg ⁡ max x ⁡ S ⁡ ( x ) \argmax_{x}S(x) . Concretely, it uses an indicator potential Φ ⁡ ( x ) = 𝟏 S ⁡ ( x ) ≥ μ t \Phi(x)=\mathbf{1}_{S(x)\geq\mu_{t}} , where μ t \mu_{t} is the ( 1 − ρ ) (1-\rho) -quantile of S S under q ψ t q_{\psi_{t}} for ρ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \rho\in(0,1) . In practice, μ t \mu_{t} is estimated by the score of the ⌈ ρ ​ N ⌉ \lceil\rho N\rceil -th best batch-sample. The indicator then retains the top-quantile samples, and the parametric family is refit to this elite set by cross-entropy minimization, typically in closed-form. We adapt this for deep-RL in Section 3 .

paragraphs.en: We derive Follow the Winners (FTW) from a CAI problem in which optimality is specified through ordinal comparisons rather than cardinal returns. The idea is to perform inference not over a single trajectory, but over a finite batch of trajectories, and to then condition this batch on an ordinal observation which specifies trajectory preference. This yields an evidence lower bound whose optimization naturally suggests a sample-and-project method: tilt the sampling distribution toward trajectories that win local comparisons, then project the resulting distribution onto the policy class.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一种 CAI 问题中推导出“跟随赢家”（FTW）策略，其中最优性是通过序数比较而非基数回报来确定的。 其核心思想不是对单条轨迹进行推理，而是对有限数量的轨迹批次进行推理，然后将该批次条件化于一个能够指定轨迹偏好的序数观察结果。 由此可得到一个证据下界，其优化过程自然地引导出一种“采样-投影”方法：将采样分布向在局部比较中获胜的轨迹倾斜，然后将所得分布投影到策略类中。

paragraphs.en: Standard CAI formulates policy optimization as inference over individual trajectories H T H_{T} , typically by conditioning on binary optimality variables 𝒪 t ∈ { 0 , 1 } \mathcal{O}_{t}\in\{0,1\} . In agentic RFT, however, scalar trajectory returns can be sparse, noisy, and difficult to calibrate across tasks, while relative comparisons among sampled rollouts are often more reliable. We therefore replace inference over individual trajectories with inference over finite collections ℬ N = ( H T 1 , … , H T N ) \mathcal{B}_{N}=(H_{T}^{1},\dots,H_{T}^{N}) . Under a base sampling policy π \pi , a collection is distributed according to the product measure p π ​ ( ℬ N ) = ∏ n = 1 N p π ​ ( H T n ) p_{\pi}(\mathcal{B}_{N})=\prod_{n=1}^{N}p_{\pi}(H_{T}^{n}) . The collection ℬ N \mathcal{B}_{N} provides a local comparison set for defining ordinal feedback.

paragraphs.en: To encode this feedback, let 𝒞 ⁡ ( ℬ N ) = ( i 1 , … , i N ) \mathcal{C}(\mathcal{B}_{N})=(i_{1},\dots,i_{N}) denote the ranking induced over the collection, where H T i 1 ≻ ⋯ ≻ H T i N H_{T}^{i_{1}}\succ\cdots\succ H_{T}^{i_{N}} . The binary optimality variable of standard CAI is then replaced by an ordinal observation variable 𝒪 T \mathcal{O}_{T} , whose support depends on the likelihood model. For instance, under a Plackett–Luce model, 𝒪 T \mathcal{O}_{T} denotes a full permutation σ \sigma of the trajectories, while for a multinomial model, 𝒪 T ∈ { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{O}_{T}\in\{1,\dots,N\} denotes the identity of a preferred trajectory. We write Φ T ​ ( ℬ N ) \Phi_{T}(\mathcal{B}_{N}) for the likelihood, or unnormalized potential, assigned to the batch ℬ N \mathcal{B}_{N} under the ordinal observation.

paragraphs.en: For simplicity, we focus on the sparse final-reward setting and condition only on 𝒪 T \mathcal{O}_{T} , avoiding partial trajectory feedback through 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} for t ≠ T t\neq T . We further assume that the ranking rule 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is consistent across subsets, satisfying independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA), which implies a total ordering over the trajectory domain ( McFadden, 1974 ; Luce, 1959 ) . This assumption is important for our algorithmic construction: IIA ensures that the per-minibatch rankings used by FTW’s elite-filtering step are consistent with an underlying total ordering of conditional returns.
paragraphs.zh: 为简化起见，我们专注于稀疏最终奖励设定，并且仅以 𝒪 T \mathcal{O}_{T} 为条件，避免通过 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t}（其中 t ≠ T）获取部分轨迹反馈。 我们进一步假设排序规则 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 在所有子集之间保持一致，满足无关替代项独立性（IIA），这意味着轨迹域存在一个全序关系（McFadden, 1974; Luce, 1959）。 这一假设对我们的算法构建至关重要：IIA 确保了 FTW 的精英筛选步骤所使用的每个小批量排序，都与条件回报的潜在全序关系保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The ELBO ℒ Φ \mathcal{L}_{\Phi} has a direct (regularized) policy-improvement interpretation. The potential Φ T \Phi_{T} tilts the proposal q q toward the preferred in-batch items, while the KL term constrains the update to the reference π θ \pi_{\theta} . Optimizing the bound therefore alternates between two simple operations: filtering better trajectories and projecting the tilted distribution onto the policy class. This structure is exactly what underpins the cross-entropy method (CEM) for optimization, as shown in Algorithm 1 .
paragraphs.zh: ELBO ℒ Φ \mathcal{L}_{\Phi} 具有直接的（正则化的）策略改进解释。 势函数 Φ T \Phi_{T} 使提议分布 q q 向批次内的首选项倾斜，而 KL 项则将更新约束在参考策略 π θ \pi_{\theta} 上。 因此，优化该界需要在两种简单操作之间交替进行：筛选更优的轨迹，并将倾斜后的分布投影到策略类中。 这种结构正是优化领域中的交叉熵方法（CEM）所依赖的基础，如算法 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: FTW instantiates an adaptation of CEM for agentic RFT. As motivated in Section 1 , we highlight three desiderata on the choice of proposal and ordinal potential relevant for the RFT setting. First, updates should be conservative: trajectory returns are high variance, and poor intermediate updates should not destabilize subsequent learning by collapsing onto noisy locally-strong trajectories. Second, variance reduction should come from the samples alone, for example through batch-level baselines ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , antithetic sampling, or rank transforms of returns, to avoid both a critic model and the environment duplication required for group rollouts. Third, the algorithm should reuse past trajectories to amortize data-collection costs and benefit from regularization and stability from replay ( Mnih et al., 2015 ; Fedus et al., 2020 ; Arnal et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: FTW 为智能体 RFT 实例化了 CEM 的一种变体。 如第 1 节所述，我们强调了在 RFT 设定中，选择提议和序数势时需要考虑的三个理想特性。 首先，更新应当保持保守：轨迹回报具有高方差，较差的中间更新不应通过收敛到充满噪声的局部优势轨迹而破坏后续的学习过程。 其次，方差降低应仅来自样本本身，例如通过批次级基线（Hu et al., 2025）、反式采样或回报的秩变换，从而避免需要批评者模型和用于群体展开的环境复制。 第三，该算法应当复用过往轨迹，以摊销数据收集成本，并从重播带来的正则化和稳定性中受益（Mnih et al., 2015；Fedus et al., 2020；Arnal et al., 2026）。

sents.en: FTW instantiates an adaptation of CEM for agentic RFT.
sents.zh: FTW 为智能体 RFT 实例化了 CEM 的一种变体。

paragraphs.en: We show our FTW pseudocode in Algorithm 2 as our adaptation of CEM (Alg. 1 ). The proposal distribution q q is the mixture of the h h past policies, approximated in practice by the empirical occupancy of a FIFO replay buffer, q ^ = 1 min ⁡ ( h , t + 1 ) ​ ∑ i = max ⁡ ( 0 , t − h + 1 ) t π θ i \hat{q}=\tfrac{1}{\min(h,\,t+1)}\sum_{i=\max(0,\,t-h+1)}^{t}\pi_{\theta_{i}} , where h h is the maximum age of samples retained in the buffer ( Cornuet et al., 2012 ) . Then, the closed-form projection step of classical CEM is replaced by a gradient-based projection onto the policy class. The main departure from standard CEM is how FTW constructs the elite set (filtering). paragraphs.en: The derivation is given in Appendix D.2 , Lemma 1 . The induced potential Φ \Phi , as shown in Figure 1 , is a degree- ( C − 1 ) (C-1) polynomial in r r and is monotonically decreasing for all K ≥ 1 K\geq 1 with K < C K<C ( Goldberg and Deb, 1991 ; David and Nagaraja, 2003 ) . Increasing K K spreads probability mass from the highest-ranked trajectories toward lower-ranked ones, softening selection pressure. The minibatch size C C acts as a concentration parameter: C = K C=K recovers uniform sampling over the buffer, while increasing C C for fixed K K sharpens concentration on high-ranked trajectories. Together, the ratio ρ = K / C \rho=K/C controls the elite fraction and C C controls how sharply that fraction is enforced. The limiting case C = N C=N with J = 1 J=1 recovers standard CEM filtering exactly, but amortizes data-collection poorly since the N − K N-K non-elite trajectories in the buffer are discarded each update. For intermediate K < C < N K<C<N , the induced selection profile becomes smoother and more sigmoid-like, as illustrated for C = 6 C=6 and K = 3 K=3 in Figure 1 . The special case K = 1 K=1 , C = 2 C=2 reduces to binary tournament selection, connecting FTW to classical selection mechanisms in genetic algorithms ( Goldberg, 1989 ; Goldberg and Deb, 1991 ) . Thus, our polynomial profile meets two of the aforementioned desiderata, conservative updates and sample-only variance reduction, purely through the ( C , K ) (C,K) filtering parameters.

paragraphs.en: This section diagnoses the characteristics of our algorithm, specifically its risk profile relative to baselines. We first recover GRPO and DPO within our extension of the CAI framework (Section 3 ) as the multinomial and Plackett-Luce potentials over sampled batches. We then use this recovery to derive the implicit risk profile of each method through the certainty equivalent of its selection rule. We show that GRPO is risk-neutral and that its otherwise (non-Jensen bounded) exponential multinomial potential is unboundedly risk-seeking. Then we show that DPO and FTW are boundedly risk-seeking toward a selection threshold that varies by the selection ratio K / C K/C . We assume reader familiarity with GRPO and DPO and provide a self-contained primer in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 本节分析了我们算法的特性，特别是其与基线方法相比的风险特征。 首先，我们在 CAI 框架的扩展（第 3 节）中重新推导了 GRPO 和 DPO，将其视为对采样批次应用的多项式分布和普莱克特-卢斯势函数。 接着，我们利用这一重新推导过程，通过各方法选择规则的确定性等价量，推导出其隐式风险特征。 我们证明了 GRPO 是风险中性的，而它原本（非詹森有界）的指数多项式势函数则是无限风险偏好的。 然后我们证明，DPO 和 FTW 在某一选择阈值上是有限风险偏好的，该阈值随选择比率 K / C K/C 而变化。 我们假设读者已熟悉 GRPO 和 DPO，并在附录 C 中提供了独立的入门介绍。

paragraphs.en: The Jensen bound comes at a cost: maximizing an upper bound does not guarantee maximization of the underlying objective. The gap is precisely the risk offset that the multinomial potential induces under uncertain returns, which we profile in the next subsection. More broadly, when viewed from this framework, the key difference between the multinomial and Plackett–Luce potentials, from which GRPO and DPO are positioned, is the choice of baseline normalizer. The multinomial potential applies a uniform group-mean across all items, while the Plackett–Luce model induces rank-dependent baselines that dampen updates at the extremes of the batch.
paragraphs.zh: 詹森界是有代价的：最大化一个上界并不保证能最大化其背后的目标函数。 这个差距正是多项式潜在函数在回报不确定时所产生的风险补偿，我们将在下一小节中对其进行剖析。 更广泛地说，从这个框架来看，多项式潜在函数与普莱克特–卢斯潜在函数（GRPO 和 DPO 均基于此）的关键区别在于基准归一化器的选择。 多项式潜在函数对所有项应用统一的组均值，而普莱克特–卢斯模型则会产生依赖于排名的基准值，从而抑制批次中极端值处的更新。

paragraphs.en: For the ordinal potentials (b) and (c), the offset is paid in how often noise swaps preference orderings within the batch rather than in the magnitude of the returns, which is also what makes it bounded. This can be desirable when σ \sigma is epistemic, since for returns with μ \mu below the attractor ( μ 0 \mu_{0} or t t ) the offset is positive and acts as an exploration term to encourage knowledge-seeking. However, when σ \sigma is aleatoric, the same offset biases the fixed point away from the mean-optimal policy, treating reward noise as if it were information ( de Vries et al., 2026 ) . GRPO’s risk-neutrality avoids both effects at the cost of neutrality. In FTW, the elite ratio K / C K/C determines the attractor of FTW. Mild filters K ≥ C / 2 K\geq C/2 place it at or below the buffer mean μ 0 \mu_{0} , it equals DPO at ( C , K ) = ( 2 , 1 ) (C,K)=(2,1) , and aggressive filters K ≪ C K\ll C place it above μ 0 \mu_{0} . For both FTW and DPO, the offset is bounded by | μ − t | |\mu-t| .
paragraphs.zh: 对于序数势 (b) 和 (c)，其偏移量体现在噪声在批次内交换偏好顺序的频率上，而非收益的幅度上，这也是使其有界的原因。 当 σ \sigma 是认识论不确定性时，这可能是可取的，因为对于 μ \mu 低于吸引子（ μ 0 \mu_{0} 或 t t ）的收益，偏移量为正，并充当探索项以鼓励知识寻求。 然而，当 σ \sigma 是随机不确定性时，相同的偏移量会使固定点偏离均值最优策略，将奖励噪声视为信息（ de Vries et al., 2026 ）。 GRPO 的风险中立性避免了这两种效应，但代价是中立性。 在 FTW 中，精英比例 K / C K/C 决定了 FTW 的吸引子。 温和的过滤器 K ≥ C / 2 K\geq C/2 将其置于缓冲均值 μ 0 \mu_{0} 处或以下；当 ( C , K ) = ( 2 , 1 ) (C,K)=(2,1) 时，它与 DPO 相等；而激进的过滤器 K ≪ C K\ll C 则使其高于 μ 0 \mu_{0} 。 对于 FTW 和 DPO，偏移量均受 | μ − t | |\mu-t| 的限制。

paragraphs.en: A separate consequence is the cardinal treatment of returns, which can be sensitive to the tail of the return distribution. The offset in (a) requires the moment-generating function of the return to be finite, which fails for heavy-tailed returns (Pareto- α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 , Student- t t with ν ≤ 2 \nu\leq 2 ). Although the Jensen bound that positions GRPO removes the offset itself, the same heavy tails destabilize GRPO’s cardinal-return baseline numerically. Rank-based potentials don’t suffer from this as they only depend on within-batch order statistics, which remain bounded for any continuous distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个独立的影响是收益率的核心处理问题，而这一问题可能对收益率分布的尾部较为敏感。 （a）中的偏移量要求收益率的矩生成函数是有限的，但对于重尾收益率（帕累托分布 α ≤ 1，学生 t 分布 ν ≤ 2），这一条件并不成立。 尽管用于定位 GRPO 的詹森界本身消除了该偏移量，但同样的重尾特性在数值上仍会破坏 GRPO 的核心收益率基线。 基于排名的势函数则不会受到这一问题影响，因为它们仅依赖于批次内的顺序统计量，而这类统计量在任何连续分布下都是有界的。

paragraphs.en: We test the predictions of Section 4 on a controlled testbed before scaling up to LLM post-training. The predictions are that GRPO is risk-neutral but numerically unstable under heavy-tailed returns and that DPO and FTW are boundedly risk-seeking toward an elite threshold set by the selection ratio K / C K/C , coinciding at ( C , K ) = ( 2 , 1 ) (C,K)=(2,1) . Furthermore, our FTW method is a general method that can be applied in the deep-RL setting, however its ordinal and conservative nature make it both slower and more stable in terms of the learning curves (compared to a baseline SAC).
paragraphs.zh: 在扩展到 LLM 后训练之前，我们在一个受控测试平台上对第 4 节的预测进行了测试。 预测结果表明：在重尾回报的情况下，GRPO 是风险中立的但数值不稳定；而 DPO 和 FTW 则会以有界的方式追求风险，直至达到由选择比率 K / C K/C 设定的精英阈值，当 (C, K) = (2, 1) 时两者一致。 此外，我们的 FTW 方法是一种通用方法，可以应用于深度强化学习场景；然而，其序数和保守的特性使其在学习曲线上既更慢也更稳定（与基准 SAC 相比）。

paragraphs.en: We construct three diagnostic tasks. The σ \sigma -trap is a multi-armed bandit in which a zero-mean distractor arm has much higher return variance than the optimal arm with mean 10 10 , σ trap ≫ σ ∗ \sigma_{\mathrm{trap}}\gg\sigma^{\ast} . A risk-neutral learner commits to the optimal arm, while a sufficiently risk-seeking learner gets distracted by the noise of the suboptimal arm as σ \sigma grows. Secondly, the Pareto- α \alpha bandit draws rewards from a truncated Pareto- α \alpha distribution and sweeps the tail index α \alpha to test whether each method’s fixed point remains well-defined as the moment-generating function diverges at α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 . Finally, the state-aliasing task collapses two distinct latent states onto the same observation with a deterministic reward, so maintaining policy stochasticity is needed for low regret. This isolates the concentration rate from the risk profile. We describe the bandit setup in more detail in Appendix G.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了三项诊断任务。 σ \sigma -陷阱是一种多臂老虎机，其中零均值干扰臂的回报方差远高于均值为 10 的最优臂，即 σ trap ≫ σ ∗ \sigma_{\mathrm{trap}}\gg\sigma^{\ast}。 风险中立的智能体会选择最优臂，而当 σ \sigma 增大时，风险偏好足够强的智能体则会被次优臂的噪声所干扰。 其次，Pareto- α \alpha 老虎机从截断的 Pareto- α \alpha 分布中抽取回报，并通过调整尾指数 α \alpha，检验当矩生成函数在 α ≤ 1 时发散时，每种方法的不变点是否仍然有明确定义。 最后，状态别名任务将两个不同的潜在状态通过确定性回报映射到同一观测结果上，因此需要保持策略的随机性以实现较低的遗憾值。 这使集中率与风险特征分离。 我们在附录 G.4 中更详细地描述了老虎机的设置。

paragraphs.en: The results in Figure 2 agree with the theory on all three items. In the σ \sigma -trap (left), GRPO converges on the optimal arm so long as its update rule remains numerically stable given the increasing gradient magnitude, which is only achieved when we decrease the learning rate as σ − 1 / 2 \sigma^{-1/2} . We also see that DPO is distracted earlier by noise than FTW, but both degrade to the same uniform policy eventually. This is the coin-flip limit which Prop. 2 predicts for bounded operators once the distractor’s draws land above and below the optimal mean with equal probability (Appendix D.3 ). Although FTW at ( 2 , 1 ) (2,1) shares DPO’s risk offset, DPO’s earlier collapse is due to its more aggressive exponential concentration in the update rule, a dynamical entrenchment effect of DPO’s loss which our fixed-point theory does not capture. As expected, the exponential potential over the buffer (FTW-exp) collapses onto the trap arm the fastest, see also Appendix H.2 for more variations of the elite-ratio parameters ( C , K ) (C,K) . On the Pareto- α \alpha bandit (center), GRPO fails to identify the optimal arm in the heavy-tailed regime, while DPO and FTW remain stable. This matches the prediction that the rank-based potential has a well-defined fixed point for any continuous return distribution whereas the cardinal-exponential potential does not. On the aliasing task (right), FTW achieves lower L1 distance | π ⁡ ( a ) − π ∗ ​ ( a ) | |\pi(a)-\pi^{*}(a)| between the learned and optimal action distributions compared to GRPO and DPO, when averaged over a learning-rate population. This is consistent with polynomial concentration retaining more stochasticity under partial observability. See Appendix H for additional Bandit results and Appendix F for a knowledge-seeking experiment left out of the main paper.
paragraphs.zh: 图2中的结果在所有三个项目上都与理论一致。 在σ陷阱（左侧）中，只要其更新规则在梯度幅值不断增大的情况下保持数值稳定，GRPO就能收敛到最优臂；而只有当我们将学习率降低为σ⁻¹/²时，才能实现这一点。 我们还观察到，DPO比FTW更早受到噪声的干扰，但两者最终都会退化为相同的均匀策略。 这是命题2对有界算子所预测的硬币翻转极限，前提是干扰项的抽取以等概率落在最优均值之上和之下（附录D.3）。 尽管(2,1)处的FTW与DPO具有相同的风险偏移，但DPO更早的崩溃源于其更新规则中更具攻击性的指数集中效应——这是DPO损失函数的一种动态固化效应，而我们的固定点理论并未捕捉到这一点。 正如预期，缓冲区上的指数势（FTW-exp）最快收敛到陷阱臂；更多精英比率参数(C,K)的变化情况亦可参见附录H.2。 在Pareto-α老虎机（中间）中，GRPO未能识别重尾分布情形下的最优臂，而DPO和FTW则保持稳定。 这与预测一致：基于排名的势在任何连续回报分布下都具有明确定义的固定点，而基数指数势则不具备。 在别名任务（右侧）中，当对学习率群体取平均时，与GRPO和DPO相比，FTW在已学习动作分布与最优动作分布之间的L1距离|π(a)−π*(a)|上表现更优。 这与多项式集中机制在部分可观测性条件下能保留更多随机性的结论一致。 更多老虎机实验结果请参见附录H，而主论文中未包含的知识探索实验则见附录F。

paragraphs.en: We also evaluate on Brax HalfCheetah ( Freeman et al., 2021 ) to check that FTW functions as a more general deep-RL algorithm. Figure 3 compares FTW-K1-C64 and FTW-K4-C64 against SAC ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) . FTW is less sample-efficient than SAC in the early phase of training, as expected from the ordinal treatment of returns that discards return magnitude. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 (left) shows test success rate curves on Sokoban. For K ∈ { 1 , 2 } K\in\{1,2\} FTW clusters with GRPO and PPO in learning speed and performance, showing that FTW performs competitively despite a much simpler update, without PPO’s value function model or GRPO’s duplicated rollouts. Notably, for K = 3 K=3 FTW collapses after peaking around 0.4 0.4 . Proposition 2 shows that this filter is relatively mild, its elite threshold for selection sits exactly at the buffer mean. Under continuous returns this means that there should be monotonic improvement (cf. the K = 3 K{=}3 , C = 4 C{=}4 bandit in Appendix H.2 ). Under Sokoban’s binary returns, however, a minibatch with fewer than K K successes fills its remaining elite slots with zero-return trajectories that the cross-entropy loss then imitates, whereas at K = 1 K=1 a single reward per minibatch would suffice. As the success rate falls this becomes more likely and the collapse reinforces itself. We attribute this to a finite-sample effect that larger batches and replay buffers dampen at the cost of slower learning (detailed in Appendix H.1 ). Finally, we also see that REINFORCE++, exhibits large seed variance and slower learning, implying that dropping group rollouts or a value function without some variance reduction replacement is insufficient on Sokoban.

paragraphs.en: The CAI framework on which we build has a long history in stochastic optimal control ( Kappen et al., 2012 ; Todorov, 2009 ; Rawlik et al., 2012 ; Theodorou et al., 2010 ) and reinforcement learning ( Levine, 2018 ; Ziebart, 2010 ; Dayan and Hinton, 1997 ; Toussaint, 2009 ) , where it has motivated methods such as MPO ( Abdolmaleki et al., 2018 ) , REPS ( Peters et al., 2010 ) , and SAC ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ) . We extend this line by recasting the tilting potential as conditioning on permutations or winner indices over sampled batches, rather than on a binary variable for individual trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们所构建的 CAI 框架在随机最优控制（Kappen 等人，2012；Todorov，2009；Rawlik 等人，2012；Theodorou 等人，2010）和强化学习（Levine，2018；Ziebart，2010；Dayan 和 Hinton，1997；Toussaint，2009）领域拥有悠久的历史，并由此催生了诸如 MPO（Abdolmaleki 等人，2018）、REPS（Peters 等人，2010）和 SAC（Haarnoja 等人，2018）等方法。 我们将这一研究脉络进一步拓展，通过将倾斜势重新表述为对采样批次中的排列或获胜索引的条件设定，而非针对单个轨迹的二元变量。

sents.en: We extend this line by recasting the tilting potential as conditioning on permutations or winner indices over sampled batches, rather than on a binary variable for individual trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Beyond GRPO and DPO, our framework subsumes a broader family of bootstrap-and-project methods. RAFT ( Dong et al., 2023 ) corresponds to FTW with C = N C=N , K = 1 K=1 , and a buffer refreshed every prompt. ReST ( Gulcehre et al., 2023 ) and ReST-EM ( Singh et al., 2024 ) bootstrap toward an annealed threshold potential before projecting back onto the model parameters. Variational best-of- n n ( Amini et al., 2025 ) shares the single-batch top-1 selection structure ( C = N C=N , K = 1 K=1 , no replay), though its KL-regularized variational objective differs from our cross-entropy projection, and STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) is closely related as a hard top-1 selection criterion. Listwise preference methods such as LiPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , PRO ( Song et al., 2024 ) , and RSO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) use the PL likelihood directly as a training objective on the policy. A complementary approach to damping concentration is generalized-entropy regularization through Tsallis entropy ( Lee et al., 2020 ) or general greedification operators ( Chan et al., 2022 ) , which for the right choice of greedification can also achieves polynomial concentration through the regularizer rather than directly through the potential. Recent work by Wu et al. (2026) also reach a related GRPO/DPO correspondence in a bottom-up way by reframing GRPO’s group-relative advantage as a contrastive loss. Our derivation arrives at the same N = 2 N=2 Bradley–Terry limit top-down as the first-stage marginal of the PL model under CAI. We provide a more comprehensive discussion of the literature and its positioning to our work in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 除了 GRPO 和 DPO，我们的框架还涵盖了更广泛的“启动-投影”方法家族。RAFT（Dong 等人，2023）对应于 C = N、K = 1 且每次提示都会刷新缓冲区的 FTW。ReST（Gulcehre 等人，2023）和 ReST-EM（Singh 等人，2024）会先向退火后的阈值势启动，然后再投影回模型参数。变分最佳-n（Amini 等人，2025）采用了单批次 top-1 选择结构（C = N、K = 1，无重播），尽管其经过 KL 正则化的变分目标与我们的交叉熵投影有所不同；而 STaR（Zelikman 等人，2022）则因采用严格的 top-1 选择标准而与之密切相关。列表级偏好方法，如 LiPO（Liu 等人，2025a）、PRO（Song 等人，2024）和 RSO（Liu 等人，2024），直接将 PL 似然用作策略的训练目标。另一种抑制集中度的互补方法是利用 Tsallis 熵（Lee 等人，2020）或通用贪心化算子（Chan 等人，2022）进行广义熵正则化；只要合理选择贪心化方式，这种方法也能通过正则化项而非势函数本身实现多项式级集中。Wu 等人（2026）近期的研究也通过自下而上的方式实现了与 GRPO/DPO 的类似对应关系，他们将 GRPO 的组内相对优势重新表述为一种对比损失。我们的推导则从自上而下得出了相同的 N = 2 Bradley–Terry 极限，这与 CAI 条件下 PL 模型的第一阶段边缘分布一致。我们在附录 B 中对相关文献及其与我们工作的关系进行了更全面的讨论。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Follow the Winners (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm for agentic LLM post-training that is adapted from the cross-entropy method for optimization. FTW induces polynomial concentration to limit aggressive policy updates which can lead to entrenchment, and uses a replay-buffer proposal to reduce sample variance without the need for a critic model or group rollouts. On agentic LLM benchmarks, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and the published Search-R1 baselines, and trains more stably and faster than REINFORCE++ on Sokoban. This supports our algorithm motivation that FTW offers a viable trade-off, spending CPU memory in place of a value model or the environment duplication that group rollouts require. To derive the algorithm, we extended the Control-as-Inference framework to encompass contemporary critic-free RFT methods by reinterpreting the tilting potential as conditioning on permutations or winner indices over sampled batches. This recovers DPO exactly under the Plackett–Luce potential and positions GRPO as the Jensen upper bound on the corresponding multinomial objective, exposing GRPO as risk-neutral while DPO and FTW share a bounded risk offset that FTW controls through its selection pressure (Proposition 2 ). The framework places GRPO, DPO, and FTW on a common design axis, and provides a top-down basis for principled algorithm design in the critic-free RFT regime.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“跟随获胜者”（Follow the Winners，FTW）算法，这是一种无需评论者的智能体大语言模型（LLM）训练后策略学习算法，其优化方法改编自交叉熵法。 FTW 引入了多项式级集中机制，以限制可能导致策略固化的激进更新，并通过重播缓冲区提案减少样本方差，而无需评论者模型或群体式推理。 在智能体大语言模型基准测试中，FTW 在 Sokoban 游戏和已发布的 Search-R1 基线模型上的表现与 GRPO 和 PPO 相当，并且在 Sokoban 游戏中的训练比 REINFORCE++ 更稳定、更快。 这支持了我们算法的设计动机：FTW 提供了一种可行的权衡方案，用 CPU 内存替代了价值模型或群体式推理所需的环境复制。 为了推导出该算法，我们将“控制即推理”框架进行了扩展，通过重新诠释倾斜势为对采样批次中的排列或获胜者索引的条件，从而涵盖了当前的无评论者 RFT 方法。 在 Plackett–Luce 势下，这一方法完全恢复了 DPO，并将 GRPO 定位为对应多项分布目标函数的 Jensen 上界，揭示了 GRPO 的风险中性特性，而 DPO 和 FTW 则共享一个有界的风险偏移量，该偏移量由 FTW 的选择压力所控制（命题 2）。 该框架将 GRPO、DPO 和 FTW 置于统一的设计轴线上，并为无评论者 RFT 机制下的原则性算法设计提供了自上而下的基础。

sents.en: We introduced Follow the Winners (FTW), a critic-free policy-learning algorithm for agentic LLM post-training that is adapted from the cross-entropy method for optimization.
sents.zh: 我们提出了“跟随获胜者”（Follow the Winners，FTW）算法，这是一种无需评论者的智能体大语言模型（LLM）训练后策略学习算法，其优化方法改编自交叉熵法。

sents.en: FTW induces polynomial concentration to limit aggressive policy updates which can lead to entrenchment, and uses a replay-buffer proposal to reduce sample variance without the need for a critic model or group rollouts.
sents.zh: FTW 引入了多项式级集中机制，以限制可能导致策略固化的激进更新，并通过重播缓冲区提案减少样本方差，而无需评论者模型或群体式推理。

sents.en: On agentic LLM benchmarks, FTW matches GRPO and PPO on Sokoban and the published Search-R1 baselines, and trains more stably and faster than REINFORCE++ on Sokoban.
sents.zh: 在智能体大语言模型基准测试中，FTW 在 Sokoban 游戏和已发布的 Search-R1 基线模型上的表现与 GRPO 和 PPO 相当，并且在 Sokoban 游戏中的训练比 REINFORCE++ 更稳定、更快。

sents.en: This supports our algorithm motivation that FTW offers a viable trade-off, spending CPU memory in place of a value model or the environment duplication that group rollouts require.
sents.zh: 这支持了我们算法的设计动机：FTW 提供了一种可行的权衡方案，用 CPU 内存替代了价值模型或群体式推理所需的环境复制。

sents.en: The framework places GRPO, DPO, and FTW on a common design axis, and provides a top-down basis for principled algorithm design in the critic-free RFT regime.

paragraphs.en: FTW’s risk offset acts as an exploration term under epistemic uncertainty, but the same offset also biases the fixed point away from the mean-optimal policy under aleatoric noise (Section 4.2 ), making FTW (and DPO) less suited to environments with large irreducible noise. The replay-buffer-based proposal amortizes data-collection costs and provides additional regularization, but at the price of memory overhead. That said, CPU memory is often cheaper and more accessible than stricter GPU requirements. Finally, our IIA assumption (Section 3 ) underlying the elite-filtering interpretation requires a total ordering on the trajectory domain, and thus needs further adaptation for non-transitive settings such as optimizing for a Nash equilibrium.
paragraphs.zh: FTW的风险补偿项在认识论不确定性下充当探索项，但同样的补偿项也会使固定点偏离在随机噪声下的均值最优策略（第4.2节），这使得FTW（以及DPO）不太适用于存在大量不可约噪声的环境。 基于重播缓冲区的提议可以摊销数据收集成本并提供额外的正则化，但需要付出内存开销的代价。 尽管如此，CPU内存通常比更严格的GPU要求更便宜且更容易获取。 最后，我们精英筛选解释所依赖的IIA假设（第3节）要求轨迹域具有全序关系，因此需要对非传递性场景（例如纳什均衡优化）进行进一步调整。

paragraphs.en: Our work contributes a general-purpose policy-learning algorithm for critic-free reinforcement fine-tuning of large language models. The contribution is methodological and is not tied to any specific deployed application, dataset, or released model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作提出了一种通用型策略学习算法，用于无需评论家的大型语言模型强化微调。 这一贡献属于方法论层面，并不局限于任何特定的部署应用、数据集或已发布的模型。

paragraphs.en: As with most advances in LLM post-training, improvements in agentic capability can in principle support beneficial applications (such as research assistants, accessibility tooling, and scientific discovery) as well as harmful ones (such as automated disinformation, scam generation, or surveillance). The conservative, polynomially-concentrating update rule introduced by FTW does not differentially advantage either direction, and we clearly document limitations (namely the risk-seeking profile under aleatoric noise) that can cause unintended effects in practice. Our experiments use publicly available pre-trained models from the Qwen2.5 family and benchmarks intended for research, and we do not release post-trained model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 与大多数大型语言模型（LLM）训练后的进步一样，智能体能力的提升原则上既能支持有益的应用（例如研究助理、无障碍工具和科学发现），也可能被用于有害的用途（例如自动化虚假信息生成、诈骗内容生成或监控）。 FTW 提出的保守型多项式集中更新规则不会偏向任何一方，并且我们明确记录了其局限性（即面对随机噪声时表现出的风险偏好倾向），这些局限性在实践中可能导致意外后果。 我们的实验使用了 Qwen2.5 系列中公开可用的预训练模型以及用于研究的基准测试，但我们并未发布经过后续训练的模型权重。

paragraphs.en: Relative to GRPO-style baselines, FTW incurs additional memory overhead from the replay buffer. This is partly offset by amortized data-collection costs, so the net compute footprint depends on the specific deployment regime; we compare the compute and memory footprints of FTW, GRPO, and PPO in Appendix G.2 . Running, debugging, and tuning large-scale RL experiments is computationally costly and carries a non-trivial environmental footprint, which we acknowledge as a known concern of this line of research.
paragraphs.zh: 与 GRPO 风格的基线方法相比，FTW 会因重播缓冲区而产生额外的内存开销。 这一部分被分摊的数据收集成本所抵消，因此净计算资源消耗取决于具体的部署模式；我们在附录 G.2 中比较了 FTW、GRPO 和 PPO 的计算与内存资源消耗。 运行、调试和优化大规模强化学习实验在计算上成本高昂，并且会产生不可忽视的环境影响，我们承认这是该研究方向的已知问题。

paragraphs.en: We situate our method relative to four strands of work: control as inference; RLHF and preference optimization; policy improvement in the critic-free setting; and CEM methods, together with a brief discussion of order statistics and their implications for our hyperparameter choices.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的方法与四个研究方向进行比较：控制作为推理；RLHF 和偏好优化；无评论家的策略改进；以及 CEM 方法，并简要讨论顺序统计量及其对我们超参数选择的影响。

paragraphs.en: The Control-as-Inference framework ( Levine, 2018 ; Ziebart, 2010 ; Ziebart et al., 2010 ; Kappen et al., 2012 ; Toussaint, 2009 ; Attias, 2003 ; Dayan and Hinton, 1997 ; Rawlik et al., 2012 ; Todorov, 2007 ; Todorov, 2009 ; Theodorou et al., 2010 ) recasts sequential decision-making as probabilistic inference in a graphical model. Under specific modelling assumptions, the posterior in this formulation coincides with the optimal or soft-optimal control law, making tools from probabilistic inference and stochastic optimal control directly applicable to the control problem. This dual formulation enables an interchange of methods between the two formalisms: examples include sequential Monte Carlo and particle filtering for planning ( Piché et al., 2019 ; Macfarlane et al., 2024 ; de Vries et al., 2025 ) , expectation-maximization for policy search as used by REPS and MPO ( Dayan and Hinton, 1997 ; Abdolmaleki et al., 2018 ; Peters et al., 2010 ) , and amortized variational inference for control ( Zintgraf et al., 2021 ; de Vries et al., 2026 ) . A further merit is that the probabilistic interpretation extends naturally to the deep reinforcement learning setting with high data throughput, since the free-energy formulation yields natural regularization for approximate policy improvement ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ; Chan et al., 2022 ; Geist et al., 2019 ) .
paragraphs.zh: Control-as-Inference 框架（Levine, 2018；Ziebart, 2010；Ziebart 等, 2010；Kappen 等, 2012；Toussaint, 2009；Attias, 2003；Dayan 和 Hinton, 1997；Rawlik 等, 2012；Todorov, 2007；Todorov, 2009；Theodorou 等, 2010）将序列决策问题重新表述为图模型中的概率推断问题。 在特定的建模假设下，该公式中的后验分布与最优或软最优控制律一致，这使得概率推断和随机最优控制领域的工具可以直接应用于控制问题。 这种双重表述使得两种形式化方法之间可以相互转换：例如，用于规划的序列蒙特卡洛和粒子滤波（Piché 等, 2019；Macfarlane 等, 2024；de Vries 等, 2025），REPS 和 MPO 使用的策略搜索中的期望最大化（Dayan 和 Hinton, 1997；Abdolmaleki 等, 2018；Peters 等, 2010），以及用于控制的摊销变分推断（Zintgraf 等, 2021；de Vries 等, 2026）。 另一个优势是，这种概率解释可以自然地扩展到具有高数据吞吐量的深度强化学习场景，因为自由能公式为近似策略改进提供了天然的正则化方法（Haarnoja 等, 2018；Chan 等, 2022；Geist 等, 2019）。

paragraphs.en: The formalism usually builds on the idea of exponentiated reward potentials that tilt a prior trajectory distribution so that the resulting posterior concentrates on high-return trajectories. Under specific choices of potential and dynamics, this recovers maximum-entropy reinforcement learning ( Ziebart et al., 2010 ) and, in the continuous-time setting with KL or quadratic control costs, a linearized form of the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman equation ( Kappen et al., 2012 ; Todorov, 2009 ; Theodorou et al., 2010 ) . The framework is usually applied in the Markov decision process setting ( Levine, 2018 ) ; we instead develop a formulation for the partially observable case, for which related treatments can be found in Abdulsamad et al. (2025) ; de Vries et al. (2026) . Our contribution differs from the standard single-trajectory exponential tilting view in two ways: we allow ordinal likelihoods over finite sets of sampled trajectories, and we replace exponential return-based tilting with a polynomial, order-statistic-based tilting mechanism. The combination with a tailored cross-entropy method for optimization yields the conservative, approximate, policy-iteration method from the main text.
paragraphs.zh: 这种形式化方法通常基于指数化的奖励势这一概念，该概念会调整先验轨迹分布，使得最终的后验分布集中于高回报的轨迹。 在特定的势函数和动力学选择下，这种方法可以还原出最大熵强化学习（Ziebart 等人，2010），并且在连续时间设定中，结合 KL 散度或二次控制成本时，可推导出哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程的一种线性化形式（Kappen 等人，2012；Todorov，2009；Theodorou 等人，2010）。 该框架通常应用于马尔可夫决策过程设定（Levine，2018）；而本文则针对部分可观测情形提出了一种新的表述形式，相关研究可见于 Abdulsamad 等人（2025）以及 de Vries 等人（2026）。 我们的贡献与标准的单轨迹指数倾斜方法存在两个不同之处：我们允许对有限采样轨迹集合进行序数似然分析，并将基于指数的回报倾斜机制替换为一种基于多项式顺序统计量的倾斜机制。 将这一方法与针对优化问题设计的定制交叉熵方法相结合，便得到了正文中提出的保守型近似策略迭代方法。

paragraphs.en: RLHF ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) has driven much of the recent LLM post-training literature. The shift toward critic-free methods such as GRPO and its variants ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and RLOO ( Kool et al., 2019a ; Ahmadian et al., 2024 ) , and toward direct preference optimization without an explicit reward model such as DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) and listwise extensions ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Song et al., 2024 ) , has produced a fragmented landscape that our derivation seeks to unify. Methods specifically targeting multi-turn agentic settings such as StarPO ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , Multi-Turn GRPO ( Wang and Ammanabrolu, 2025 ; Wei et al., 2025a ) , or GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) share our operational regime but treat the multi-turn structure through specialized advantage estimators or credit-assignment heuristics, rather than through a top-down probabilistic framework.
paragraphs.zh: RLHF（Christiano 等人，2017；Stiennon 等人，2020；Ouyang 等人，2022）推动了近期大量关于 LLM 后训练的研究。 向无需批评者的方法（如 GRPO 及其变体（Shao 等人，2024；Yu 等人，2025；Liu 等人，2025b；Liu 等人，2026）、REINFORCE++（Hu 等人，2025）和 RLOO（Kool 等人，2019a；Ahmadian 等人，2024）），以及无需显式奖励模型的直接偏好优化方法（如 DPO（Rafailov 等人，2023）及其列表级扩展（Liu 等人，2025a；Song 等人，2024））的转变，导致研究格局碎片化，而我们的推导旨在实现统一。 专门针对多轮智能体场景的方法，如 StarPO（Wang 等人，2025b）、Multi-Turn GRPO（Wang 和 Ammanabrolu，2025；Wei 等人，2025a）或 GiGPO（Feng 等人，2025），与我们采用的操作框架一致，但它们通过专门的收益估计器或信用分配启发式方法处理多轮结构，而非采用自上而下的概率框架。

paragraphs.en: Within this landscape, our framework places GRPO-family and DPO-family methods on a common axis (subset size N N and choice of likelihood) and identifies common heuristics such as group baselines, shared prefixes, and contrastive losses as consequences of specific top-down modelling choices rather than fundamental algorithmic differences. Although we discussed RAFT ( Dong et al., 2023 ) and similar methods in the main text, the off-policy extension was introduced by RAFT++ ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) which is parallel to our use of the replay buffer. A closely related thread is STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) , which bootstraps a reasoning policy by iteratively fine-tuning on self-generated rationales that lead to correct answers, and can be viewed as a degenerate form of bootstrap-and-project with a hard top-1 selection criterion. Recent work by Wu et al. (2026) reaches a related correspondence bottom-up by reframing GRPO’s group-relative advantage as a contrastive loss, and shows a gradient-level equivalence in the N = 2 N=2 case. Our derivation arrives at the same N = 2 N{=}2 Bradley-Terry limit top-down as the first-stage marginal of the PL model under CAI, and takes a broader perspective through the lens of tilting potentials (i.e., the Multinomial or Plackett-Luce).
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，我们的框架将 GRPO 系列和 DPO 系列方法置于一个共同的轴线上（子集大小 N 和对可能性的选择），并指出群体基线、共享前缀和对比损失等常见启发式方法，实际上是特定自上而下建模选择的后果，而非根本性的算法差异。 尽管我们在正文中讨论了 RAFT（Dong 等人，2023）及类似方法，但其离策略扩展是由 RAFT++（Xiong 等人，2025）提出的，这与我们的重播缓冲区使用方式并行。 一个密切相关的研究方向是 STaR（Zelikman 等人，2022），它通过迭代地在能产生正确答案的自我生成推理依据上进行微调来引导推理策略，可被视为一种带有严格 top-1 选择标准的“引导-投影”方法的退化形式。Wu 等人近期的工作 （2026）则从自下而上的角度建立了类似的对应关系：他们将 GRPO 的群体相对优势重新表述为一种对比损失，并在 N = 2 的情况下证明了梯度层面的等价性。 我们的推导过程自上而下得出了与 N = 2 情况下的 Bradley-Terry 极限相同的结果，该结果也与 CAI 条件下 PL 模型的第一阶段边缘分布一致，并通过倾斜势（即多项式分布或 Plackett-Luce 分布）的视角提供了更广泛的见解。

paragraphs.en: The Plackett-Luce (PL) family is one of several ordinal potentials our framework admits, and the one through which we recover DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) as the N = 2 N{=}2 special case. This places our work in contact with a long line of research on PL-based ranking outside of LLM alignment. Classical learning-to-rank ( Cao et al., 2007 ; Xia et al., 2008 ; Oosterhuis, 2022 ) fits a parameterized scoring function to observed rankings via maximum likelihood under PL or related listwise losses. Our formulation is closest to PL-Rank ( Oosterhuis, 2022 ) , but differs in two ways. First, we do not parameterize the PL model on an external scoring function. Instead, our PL likelihood arises from the Control-as-Inference construction ( Levine, 2018 ) over sampled trajectory collections, and the policy is updated through the resulting posterior rather than fit to PL labels directly. Second, the CAI derivation supplies a KL-regularization term against a reference policy that is absent in standard listwise learning-to-rank.
paragraphs.zh: Plackett-Luce（PL）族是我们框架所支持的一系列序数势函数之一，并且当 N = 2 时，它可还原为 DPO（Rafailov 等人，2023）这一特例。 这使得我们的工作与长期存在的、基于 PL 的排名研究（而非 LLM 对齐领域）产生了联系。 经典的“学习排序”方法（Cao 等人，2007；Xia 等人，2008；Oosterhuis，2022）通过最大似然法，在 PL 或相关的列表损失框架下，将参数化的评分函数拟合到观测到的排名数据中。 我们的公式与 PL-Rank（Oosterhuis，2022）最为接近，但存在两点不同。 首先，我们没有在外部评分函数上对 PL 模型进行参数化。 相反，我们的 PL 似然源于基于采样轨迹集合的“控制即推理”构建方式（Levine，2018），策略是通过由此得到的后验分布进行更新，而非直接拟合 PL 标签。 其次，“控制即推理”的推导过程引入了一个针对参考策略的 KL 正则化项，而标准的列表式“学习排序”方法中并不包含该项。

paragraphs.en: Preference-based policy learning ( Akrour et al., 2011 ) , and its deep RL version ( Christiano et al., 2017 ) , form another branch in reinforcement learning that learns a preference model on trajectory data as a surrogate for the reward. This surrogate is then optimized akin to a value function instead of the direct returns. DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) collapses this two-stage procedure into a single objective under a Bradley-Terry model, and sketches a PL generalization in their Appendix A.3. Our derivation can be read as making their sketch more explicit. The PL likelihood is recovered top-down from CAI rather than imposed as a ranking loss, which yields the ELBO and its policy gradient for optimization as consequences rather than design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 基于偏好的策略学习（Akrour 等人，2011）及其深度强化学习版本（Christiano 等人，2017）构成了强化学习中的另一分支，该分支通过在轨迹数据上学习偏好模型来替代奖励函数。 随后，这种替代奖励函数会像价值函数一样被优化，而非直接优化即时回报。 DPO（Rafailov 等人，2023）在 Bradley-Terry 模型框架下将这一两阶段流程整合为单一目标，并在其附录 A.3 中勾勒出了偏好学习的一般化形式。 我们的推导过程可以理解为对其所提出的概括性描述进行了更明确的展开。 偏好学习的似然函数是从 CAI 自上而下恢复得出的，而非作为排序损失直接引入；因此，ELBO 及其策略梯度是优化过程中的自然结果，而非预先设定的设计选择。

paragraphs.en: Listwise preference optimization methods such as LiPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) and PRO ( Song et al., 2024 ) use the same PL likelihood as a training objective directly on the LLM’s response distribution. Rather than fitting an external scoring function as in classical LTR, they treat the policy itself as the PL ranker over candidate responses, perhaps similar to standard learning-to-rank. The two methods differ in their loss construction. LiPO uses a rank-aware listwise loss inspired by LambdaRank ( Burges et al., 2007 ) , which weights each pair by its contribution to a target ranking metric. PRO uses sequential elimination with a Bradley-Terry-style contrast at each rank position, which is one approach to sample from the standard PL factorization. RSO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) is closely related and uses Boltzmann acceptance to source preference data closer to the optimal policy, which connects to our (ordinal) exponential-tilting view in Section 2 but without the ELBO grounding.
paragraphs.zh: LiPO（Liu 等人，2025a）和 PRO（Song 等人，2024）等列表偏好优化方法直接使用相同的 PL 似然作为训练目标，直接作用于 LLM 的响应分布。 与经典 LTR 中拟合外部评分函数不同，这些方法将策略本身视为候选响应的 PL 排序器，或许类似于标准的排序学习。 这两种方法在损失函数的构建方式上有所不同。 LiPO 采用受 LambdaRank（Burges 等人，2007）启发的感知排名的列表损失，该损失根据每对响应对于目标排名指标的贡献度进行加权。 PRO 采用顺序淘汰策略，并在每个排名位置使用 Bradley-Terry 风格的对比，这是从标准 PL 因子分解中采样的方法之一。 RSO（Liu 等人，2024）与之密切相关，它利用玻尔兹曼接受度来生成更接近最优策略的偏好数据，这与我们在第 2 节中提出的（序数）指数倾斜观点相关，但缺乏 ELBO 的支撑。

sents.zh: LiPO（Liu 等人，2025a）和 PRO（Song 等人，2024）等列表偏好优化方法直接使用相同的 PL 似然作为训练目标，直接作用于 LLM 的响应分布。

sents.en: Rather than fitting an external scoring function as in classical LTR, they treat the policy itself as the PL ranker over candidate responses, perhaps similar to standard learning-to-rank.
sents.zh: 与经典 LTR 中拟合外部评分函数不同，这些方法将策略本身视为候选响应的 PL 排序器，或许类似于标准的排序学习。

sents.en: The two methods differ in their loss construction.
sents.zh: 这两种方法在损失函数的构建方式上有所不同。

sents.en: LiPO uses a rank-aware listwise loss inspired by LambdaRank ( Burges et al., 2007 ) , which weights each pair by its contribution to a target ranking metric.
sents.zh: LiPO 采用受 LambdaRank（Burges 等人，2007）启发的感知排名的列表损失，该损失根据每对响应对于目标排名指标的贡献度进行加权。

sents.en: PRO uses sequential elimination with a Bradley-Terry-style contrast at each rank position, which is one approach to sample from the standard PL factorization.
sents.zh: PRO 采用顺序淘汰策略，并在每个排名位置使用 Bradley-Terry 风格的对比，这是从标准 PL 因子分解中采样的方法之一。

sents.en: RSO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) is closely related and uses Boltzmann acceptance to source preference data closer to the optimal policy, which connects to our (ordinal) exponential-tilting view in Section 2 but without the ELBO grounding.
sents.zh: RSO（Liu 等人，2024）与之密切相关，它利用玻尔兹曼接受度来生成更接近最优策略的偏好数据，这与我们在第 2 节中提出的（序数）指数倾斜观点相关，但缺乏 ELBO 的支撑。

paragraphs.en: The classical policy improvement theorem ( Howard, 1960 ; Sutton and Barto, 2018 ) states that replacing actions by those with higher Q-value under the current policy yields a non-degrading update. This guarantee is the foundation of approximate policy iteration, and it depends on having access to a Q Q -estimate against which to greedify. In conventional deep reinforcement learning that estimate comes from a parametric value function trained alongside the policy, and a substantial body of work studies how to effectively estimate Q Q ( Mnih et al., 2015 ; van Hasselt et al., 2016 ; Munos et al., 2016 ) and how aggressively to move the policy toward its argmax ( Kakade and Langford, 2002 ) . For instance, Chan et al. (2022) formalize greedification through forward and reverse KL projections, showing that the choice of divergence materially affects stability. Oren et al. (2025) extend the view to actor-critic methods and show that more conservative greedification operators improve performance in the deep setting. Trust-region methods such as TRPO and PPO ( Schulman et al., 2015 ; Schulman et al., 2017 ) , and relative-entropy policy search ( Peters et al., 2010 ) , take a complementary route by constraining the magnitude of the per-step policy update against a reference policy. On the theoretical side, Mei et al. (2020a) ; Mei et al. (2020b) ; Beirami et al. (2025) show that softmax policy gradient and best-of-n methods concentrate exponentially fast on the argmax-action for the current value estimate, which can be desirable for swift convergence when the estimate is well-calibrated.
paragraphs.zh: 经典的策略改进定理（Howard，1960；Sutton和Barto，2018）指出，在当前策略下用Q值更高的动作替换现有动作，会实现一个性能不下降的更新。 这一保证是近似策略迭代的基石，它依赖于能够获取一个用于贪心选择的Q值估计。 在传统的深度强化学习中，该估计值来自与策略一同训练的参数化价值函数，大量研究致力于探索如何有效估计Q值（Mnih等，2015；van Hasselt等，2016；Munos等，2016），以及如何激进地将策略向其argmax方向调整（Kakade和Langford，2002）。 例如，Chan等 （2022）通过前向和后向KL投影对贪心化进行了形式化描述，表明发散函数的选择会显著影响稳定性。Oren等 （2025）将这一视角扩展到演员-评论家方法，并证明在深度学习中，更保守的贪心化算子能提升性能。 信任区域方法（如TRPO和PPO，Schulman等，2015；Schulman等，2017）以及相对熵策略搜索（Peters等，2010）则采取了互补的路径：它们通过约束每一步策略更新相对于参考策略的幅度来实现控制。 在理论层面，Mei等（2020a）；Mei等（2020b）；Beirami等 （2025）表明，softmax策略梯度和最佳n选一方法能指数级快速集中于当前价值估计对应的argmax动作；当估计值校准良好时，这种特性可能有助于实现快速收敛。

paragraphs.en: Critic-free RFT for LLMs breaks the assumption underlying this toolbox. Methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and RAFT ( Dong et al., 2023 ) discard the value function for compute reasons and replace it with batch-relative statistics: the group-mean baseline in GRPO, the global advantage normalization in REINFORCE++, the top- 1 1 winner in RAFT. The estimate against which the policy is greedified is no longer a stable function approximator but a Monte Carlo statistic over N N samples per prompt. For small N N this estimate is high-variance, and the exponential concentration of softmax policy gradients amplifies that variance into the policy update. This can cause entrenchment , where one trajectory with large positive empirical advantage receives an outsized push, and the policy commits to it before subsequent samples can correct the estimate. KL-regularization slows this commitment but does not eliminate it ( Geist et al., 2019 ) , since the asymptotic concentration profile of the soft-optimal policy is unchanged by the size of the KL coefficient. The view that conservative updates protect against estimator noise is well-established for value-based methods, where double Q-learning ( van Hasselt et al., 2016 ) and clipped twin Q-targets ( Fujimoto et al., 2018 ) address overestimation bias from value-function noise. Our argument transposes this concern to the policy side and to the critic-free setting.
paragraphs.zh: 针对大型语言模型的无批评者 RFT 方法打破了该工具箱所依赖的基本假设。 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）、REINFORCE++（Hu 等人，2025）和 RAFT（Dong 等人，2023）等方法出于计算效率的考虑，摒弃了价值函数，并用批内相对统计量取而代之：GRPO 使用组均值基线，REINFORCE++ 使用全局优势归一化，而 RAFT 则使用 top-1 获胜者。 策略据此进行贪心优化的估计值不再是一个稳定的函数近似器，而是每个提示词基于 N 个样本的蒙特卡洛统计量。 当 N 较小时，该估计值具有高方差，而 softmax 策略梯度的指数级集中效应会将这种方差放大到策略更新中。 这可能导致“固化”现象：某条具有较大正向经验优势的轨迹会获得过度增强的推动，使得策略在后续样本能够修正该估计值之前便已锁定该轨迹。 KL 正则化可以减缓这种固化的过程，但无法完全消除（Geist 等人，2019），因为软最优策略的渐近集中特性不受 KL 系数大小的影响。 保守更新能够防范估计器噪声的观点在基于价值的方法中已得到广泛认可，例如双重 Q-learning（van Hasselt 等人，2016）和截断双 Q 目标（Fujimoto 等人，2018）均可缓解价值函数噪声引起的过高估计偏差。 我们的论证将这一关注点转移到了策略层面，并应用于无批评者的场景。

paragraphs.en: Our work proposes a different lever for controlling concentration in this critic-free regime through the shape of the tilting potential. Follow the Winners induces a polynomial concentration in the order statistic of returns rather than the exponential concentration of softmax-based methods (see Section 3 ). In essence, our polynomial potential approach dampens the concentration target, and the KL regularizer bounds how quickly the policy moves toward it. A complementary mechanism for damping concentration is generalized-entropy regularization, where Tsallis entropy ( Lee et al., 2020 ) replaces the standard KL or Shannon term and yields polynomial-tailed policies in the limit. This achieves polynomial concentration through the regularizer rather than the potential, and the two approaches are formally distinct: Tsallis-regularized policies are polynomial in the advantage relative to a reference, whereas our potential is polynomial in the order statistic of within-batch returns. The two could in principle be combined, although we leave that to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作提出了一种不同的控制机制，通过倾斜势能的形状，在这一无需评论者的框架中控制集中性。 “跟随获胜者”策略在回报的顺序统计量中诱导了多项式集中性，而非基于 softmax 的方法所具有的指数级集中性（参见第 3 节）。 本质上，我们的多项式势能方法会减弱集中性目标，而 KL 正则化项则限制了策略向其靠拢的速度。 另一种减弱集中性的互补机制是广义熵正则化，其中 Tsallis 熵（Lee et al., 2020）取代了标准的 KL 或 Shannon 项，并在极限情况下产生具有多项式尾部的策略。 这种方法通过正则化项而非势能实现了多项式集中性，且两种方法在形式上存在区别：经过 Tsallis 正则化的策略相对于参考优势呈多项式关系，而我们的势能则与批次内回报的顺序统计量呈多项式关系。 原则上，这两种方法可以结合使用，但我们将此留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: One asymptotic benefit of the polynomial potential over the exponential is reduced sensitivity to noisy return estimations. Firstly, the update depends on within-batch ranking rather than on the magnitude of the empirical advantage. Secondly, the implicit risk preference induced by exponential tilting grows quadratically with the noise scale of the empirical mean, whereas under a rank-based potential it grows only linearly and saturates at the upper quantile of the noise distribution. We sketch this argument informally in Appendix D . This effect is less crucial in critic-augmented settings, where value estimation can absorb part of the noise, but it is directly relevant in critic-free RFT, where the only fallback is the batch average itself.
paragraphs.zh: 多项式势相对于指数势的一个渐近优势在于，它对噪声较大的回报估计的敏感度更低。 首先，更新依赖于批次内的排序，而非经验优势的绝对大小。 其次，由指数倾斜引起的隐式风险偏好会随着经验均值的噪声尺度呈二次增长，而在基于排序的势函数下，这种增长仅为线性，并在噪声分布的上分位数处达到饱和。 我们在附录 D 中非正式地概述了这一论证。 在引入评论家的设置中，这种影响的重要性较低，因为价值估计可以吸收部分噪声；但在无评论家的 RFT 中，这种影响则直接相关，因为唯一的备用方案就是批次平均值本身。

paragraphs.en: The cross-entropy method ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; Rubinstein, 1999 ; Botev et al., 2013 ) has been applied to reinforcement learning along two main lines, neither of which matches our usage. The first treats CEM as a black-box policy-search method, where the elite-filtering step operates over policy parameters directly. Mannor et al. (2003) introduced this for fast policy search, and Pourchot and Sigaud (2019) extend it by combining CEM with gradient-based actor-critic updates to obtain a population-based hybrid. The second uses CEM as a short-horizon planner over learned dynamics models, where the elite-filtering step operates over candidate action sequences rather than policy parameters. PETS ( Chua et al., 2018 ) , PlaNet ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) , the differentiable CEM of Amos and Yarats (2020) , and the sample-efficient iCEM of Pinneri et al. (2021) all fall into this category.
paragraphs.zh: 交叉熵方法（Rubinstein, 1997；Rubinstein, 1999；Botev 等，2013）在强化学习领域主要沿两条路线应用，但这两者均与我们的用法不符。第一条路线将 CEM 视为一种黑箱策略搜索方法，其中精英筛选步骤直接作用于策略参数。Mannor 等（2003）首次提出这种方法以实现快速策略搜索，而 Pourchot 和 Sigaud（2019）则通过将 CEM 与基于梯度的演员-评论家更新相结合，将其扩展为一种基于种群的混合方法。第二条路线则将 CEM 用作基于已学习动态模型的短期规划器，其中精英筛选步骤作用于候选动作序列，而非策略参数。PETS（Chua 等，2018）、PlaNet（Hafner 等，2019）、Amos 和 Yarats（2020）提出的可微分 CEM，以及 Pinneri 等（2021）提出的样本高效的 iCEM，均属于这一类别。

paragraphs.en: Our usage differs from both lines: Follow the Winners instead applies CEM elite-filtering as an optimization step for an ELBO derived from a Control-as-Inference graphical model, where the optimization targets either an amortized variational inference or expectation-maximization scheme. Furthermore, we approximate the elite set for the projection step as a collection of trajectories drawn from the replay buffer rather than parameters or action sequences. The CEM step then acts as the bootstrap-and-project component of an approximate policy-improvement operator, with the empirical cross-entropy projection mapping the filtered trajectories back onto the policy parameters via SGD. This connects the CEM elite-filtering operator to the order-statistics analysis of Section 3 , which are not present in any of the prior CEM-RL applications. A practical consequence is that our method does not require a learned dynamics model (unlike planner-style CEM) and does not maintain a population of policies (unlike CEM-RL), which keeps it compatible with the critic-free RFT setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的用法与这两种方法都不同：“Follow the Winners”方法将 CEM 精英筛选用作一种优化步骤，用于从“控制即推理”图模型中推导出的 ELBO，其中优化的目标是摊销变分推断或期望最大化方案。 此外，我们将投影步骤中的精英集近似为从重播缓冲区中抽取的轨迹集合，而非参数或动作序列的集合。 随后，CEM 步骤充当近似策略改进算子的“引导与投影”组件，其中经验交叉熵投影通过 SGD 将筛选后的轨迹映射回策略参数。 这将 CEM 精英筛选算子与第 3 节中的顺序统计量分析联系起来，而这些分析在以往的任何 CEM-RL 应用中均未出现。 一个实际影响是，我们的方法不需要学习动态模型（与规划器风格的 CEM 不同），也不维护策略种群（与 CEM-RL 不同），因此能够与无需评论家的 RFT 设置保持兼容。

sents.en: Our usage differs from both lines: Follow the Winners instead applies CEM elite-filtering as an optimization step for an ELBO derived from a Control-as-Inference graphical model, where the optimization targets either an amortized variational inference or expectation-maximization scheme.

sents.en: Furthermore, we approximate the elite set for the projection step as a collection of trajectories drawn from the replay buffer rather than parameters or action sequences.

sents.en: The CEM step then acts as the bootstrap-and-project component of an approximate policy-improvement operator, with the empirical cross-entropy projection mapping the filtered trajectories back onto the policy parameters via SGD.

paragraphs.en: The tournament-selection scheme used by Follow the Winners (Section 3 , Lemma 1 ) draws on classical literature in order statistics and evolutionary computation. The marginal probability of selection by tournament rank is a standard order-statistics result ( David and Nagaraja, 2003 ; Johnson et al., 1997 ) , and tournament selection itself is a foundational operator in genetic algorithms (GAs) ( Goldberg, 1989 ; Goldberg and Deb, 1991 ) where the trade-off between tournament size and selection pressure has been studied extensively. The K = 1 K=1 , C = 2 C=2 case of our Eq. ( 13 ) recovers binary tournament selection exactly. Relative to the GA literature, our contribution is to embed tournament selection inside a probabilistic framework: the resulting empirical occupancy is shown in Section 3 to act as an implicit tilting distribution that targets the upper quantile of returns without explicit potential evaluation. This connects the GA-style operator to the cross-entropy method for optimization ( Rubinstein, 1997 ; Rubinstein, 1999 ; Botev et al., 2013 ) discussed in the previous subsection. When C = N C=N , our scheme reduces to standard CEM elite-filtering applied to the buffer, making the GA-style and CEM-style perspectives literally equivalent in this limit. A separate but adjacent thread is sampling without replacement from a Plackett-Luce distribution via the Gumbel-top- k k trick ( Gumbel, 1954 ; Kool et al., 2019b ) , which we use to sample full PL rankings efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: “跟随获胜者”（第 3 节，引理 1）所采用的锦标赛选择方案借鉴了顺序统计量和进化计算领域的经典文献。 根据锦标赛排名被选中的边际概率是一个标准的顺序统计量结果（David 和 Nagaraja，2003；Johnson 等，1997），而锦标赛选择本身是遗传算法（GA）的基础算子（Goldberg，1989；Goldberg 和 Deb，1991），其中锦标赛规模与选择压力之间的权衡已被广泛研究。 我们公式 (13) 中 K = 1、C = 2 的情况 恰好还原了二元锦标赛选择。 相较于遗传算法文献，我们的贡献在于将锦标赛选择嵌入到一个概率框架中：如第 3 节所示，由此产生的经验占用率充当了一种隐式的倾斜分布，无需显式评估潜在值即可针对收益的上分位数。 这将遗传算法风格的算子与前一小节讨论的优化交叉熵方法（Rubinstein，1997；Rubinstein，1999；Botev 等，2013）联系起来。 当 C = N 时，我们的方案简化为对缓冲区应用的标准 CEM 精英过滤，使得在这种极限情况下，遗传算法风格和 CEM 风格的视角在字面上完全等价。 另一个相关但独立的思路是通过 Gumbel-top-k 技巧（Gumbel，1954；Kool 等，2019b）从 Plackett-Luce 分布中进行无放回采样，我们利用这一方法高效地采样完整的 PL 排名。

paragraphs.en: Group-Relative Policy Optimization ( Shao et al., 2024 ) is a critic-free policy-gradient method built on PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) . For each prompt it samples a group of N N trajectories from the current policy, scores their returns G 1 , … , G N G_{1},\ldots,G_{N} , and replaces the learned value baseline of actor-critic methods with the group statistics through the advantage A i = ( G i − G ¯ ) / σ G A_{i}=(G_{i}-\bar{G})/\sigma_{G} , where G ¯ \bar{G} and σ G \sigma_{G} are the group mean and standard deviation. The policy maximizes the PPO-style clipped objective with a KL penalty toward a reference policy,
paragraphs.zh: 群体相对策略优化（Shao 等人，2024）是一种基于 PPO（Schulman 等人，2017）的无需评论家的策略梯度方法。 对于每个提示，该方法会从当前策略中采样一组 N 条轨迹，计算它们的回报 G₁, …, Gₙ，并通过优势函数 Aᵢ = (Gᵢ − Ġ) / σ_G 将演员-评论家方法中学习到的价值基线替换为群体统计量，其中 Ġ 和 σ_G 分别是群体的均值和标准差。 该策略通过最大化带有 KL 惩罚项的 PPO 风格裁剪目标函数来优化自身，并朝向一个参考策略调整。

paragraphs.en: Setup. Each buffer entry carries a trajectory H T i H_{T}^{i} and a return G i ∼ P ( ⋅ ∣ H T i ) G_{i}\sim P(\cdot\mid H_{T}^{i}) , drawn independently across entries. Write μ ⁡ ( H T ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ G ∣ H T ] \mu(H_{T})=\mathbb{E}[G\mid H_{T}] and σ 2 ​ ( H T ) = Var ⁡ [ G ∣ H T ] \sigma^{2}(H_{T})=\mathrm{Var}[G\mid H_{T}] . When we resample data from the buffer, we treat sampled returns as i.i.d. from the population marginal F 0 F_{0} induced by the buffer’s occupancy (density f 0 f_{0} where the return family is continuous). The buffer’s empirical distribution estimates F 0 F_{0} up to finite-sample error, and we assume for methods like GRPO that the buffer is simply refreshed at each iteration to fit within this framing. The ordinal operators compare returns, and discrete families produce ties, which we break uniformly at random. This tie-breaking is captured by the randomized grade of a return value g g , U ⁡ ( g ) = Pr ⁡ ( G ′ < g ) + V ⋅ Pr ⁡ ( G ′ = g ) U(g)=\Pr(G^{\prime}<g)+V\cdot\Pr(G^{\prime}=g) with G ′ ∼ F 0 G^{\prime}\sim F_{0} and V ∼ Unif ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) V\sim\mathrm{Unif}(0,1) refreshed at each comparison and U ⁡ ( g ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U(g)\in[0,1] . In words, the grade is the fraction of buffer mass strictly below g g , plus a uniformly random position within the tie mass at g g , so comparing returns with tie coin-flips is the same as comparing grades. For continuous families the grade reduces to the buffer quantile F 0 ​ ( g ) F_{0}(g) , and the grade of a buffer draw is Unif ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathrm{Unif}(0,1) .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 每个缓冲区条目都携带一条轨迹 H T i H_{T}^{i} 和一个回报 G i ∼ P ( ⋅ ∣ H T i ) G_{i}\sim P(\cdot\mid H_{T}^{i})，且各条目之间相互独立抽取。 定义 μ ⁡ ( H T ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ G ∣ H T ] \mu(H_{T})=\mathbb{E}[G\mid H_{T}] 和 σ 2 ​ ( H T ) = Var ⁡ [ G ∣ H T ] \sigma^{2}(H_{T})=\mathrm{Var}[G\mid H_{T}]。 当从缓冲区重新采样数据时，我们将采样得到的回报视为来自由缓冲区占用情况所诱导的总体边际分布 F 0 F_{0} 的独立同分布样本（密度为 f 0 f_{0}，其中回报族是连续的）。 缓冲区的经验分布对 F 0 F_{0} 的估计存在有限样本误差；对于 GRPO 这类方法，我们假设缓冲区在每次迭代时都会被刷新，以符合这一框架。 序数算子用于比较回报，而离散分布族会产生平局，我们以均匀随机方式打破这些平局。 这种打破平局的方式由回报值 g g 的随机化等级体现：U ⁡ ( g ) = Pr ⁡ ( G ′ < g ) + V ⋅ Pr ⁡ ( G ′ = g ) U(g)=\Pr(G^{\prime}<g)+V\cdot\Pr(G^{\prime}=g)，其中 G ′ ∼ F 0 G^{\prime}\sim F_{0}，且 V ∼ Unif ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) V\sim\mathrm{Unif}(0,1) 在每次比较时都会被刷新，同时 U ⁡ ( g ) ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] U(g)\in[0,1]。 换言之，该等级等于缓冲区中严格低于 g g 的质量比例，加上在 g g 处的平局质量区间内一个均匀随机位置；因此，通过抛硬币的方式比较回报，等同于比较这些等级。 对于连续分布族，该等级简化为缓冲区的分位数 F 0 ​ ( g ) F_{0}(g)，而缓冲区抽取值的等级则服从 Unif ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathrm{Unif}(0,1)。

paragraphs.en: GRPO : The Jensen surrogate of the Rao-Blackwellized MNL-exp (Proposition 1 ) which scores each entry by the group-mean advantage, so φ ⁡ ( g ) = g / τ \varphi(g)=g/\tau .

paragraphs.en: DPO (pairwise): the winner of a pair is the higher grade in randomly drawn comparisons. Thus, an entry with grade U ⁡ ( g ) U(g) gives φ ⁡ ( g ) = 𝔼 V ​ [ U ⁡ ( g ) ] \varphi(g)=\mathbb{E}_{V}[U(g)] , the win rate averaged over ties.

paragraphs.en: A few remarks. First, ℛ φ ≠ 0 \mathcal{R}_{\varphi}\neq 0 requires a non-degenerate return law and a non-affine φ \varphi . Second, as the noise vanishes, G → μ ⁡ ( H T ) G\to\mu(H_{T}) and every cell of Table 1 gives ℛ = 0 \mathcal{R}=0 . Third, an affine utility commutes with the expectation, so J φ = μ J_{\varphi}=\mu and ℛ φ = 0 \mathcal{R}_{\varphi}=0 exactly, which settles the GRPO row in every column of Table 1 . Then finally, the score can be ambiguous. For example, take two buffers with values { 0 , 3 , 10 } \{0,3,10\} and { 0 , 7 , 10 } \{0,7,10\} : the grade would be equal for items 3 and 7 despite taking on different actual values. In words, ordinal operators resolve only the ordering of returns and not their values, so the inverse φ − 1 \varphi^{-1} covers an interval rather than a single number. In these cases, we write 0 † 0^{\dagger} whenever the operator still ranks entries properly by their mean return, to distinguish an inexpressible offset from a computed zero.
paragraphs.zh: 几点说明。 首先，ℛ φ ≠ 0 \mathcal{R}_{\varphi}\neq 0 需要非退化的回报定律和非仿射的 φ \varphi 。 其次，当噪声消失时，G → μ ⁡ ( H T ) G\to\mu(H_{T})，且表1中的每个单元格都会得到 ℛ = 0 \mathcal{R}=0 。 第三，仿射效用与期望值可交换，因此 J φ = μ J_{\varphi}=\mu 且 ℛ φ = 0 \mathcal{R}_{\varphi}=0 完全成立，这便确定了表1每一列中 GRPO 行的结果。 最后，得分可能是模糊的。 例如，考虑两个缓冲区，其值分别为 { 0 , 3 , 10 } \{0,3,10\} 和 { 0 , 7 , 10 } \{0,7,10\}：尽管第3项和第7项的实际值不同，但它们的等级却相同。 换言之，序数算子仅能确定回报的顺序，而非其具体数值，因此逆函数 φ − 1 \varphi^{-1} 对应的是一个区间，而非单个数值。 在这些情况下，只要该算子仍能根据平均回报正确排序各项，我们就写作 0 † 0^{\dagger}，以将无法表达的偏移量与计算出的零区分开来。

This is linear in μ ⁡ ( H T ) \mu(H_{T}) with a shared constant. Marginally over the buffer the advantage averages to zero, but the conditional average determines the ranking in again a linear fashion. Thus ℛ = 0 \mathcal{R}=0 .

To formalize this, we will standardize an entry’s returns according to its own law G = μ + σ ​ Z G=\mu+\sigma Z with Z ​ = Δ ​ ( G − μ ) / σ Z\overset{\Delta}{=}(G-\mu)/\sigma . This assumes nothing but gives us Z Z with mean 0 0 , variance 1 1 , while preserving the underlying family (Table 1 ). Each of the C − 1 C-1 competitors are then also standardized but by the buffer’s ( μ 0 , σ 0 ) (\mu_{0},\sigma_{0}) . This holds exactly for the continuous columns, since every Gaussian standardizes to 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}(0,1) . For the exponential law we know that the mean and standard deviation are both 1 / θ 1/\theta , so Z = ( G − 1 / θ ) / ( 1 / θ ) = θ ​ G − 1 Z=(G-1/\theta)/(1/\theta)=\theta G-1 , and θ ​ G ∼ Exp ⁡ ( 1 ) \theta G\sim\mathrm{Exp}(1) for any rate θ \theta . This recipe fails for the discrete columns since a linear standardization can only fix the first two moments and their third and higher moments will still depend on the parameter.

paragraphs.en: Read top to bottom, Table 1 orders the operators by risk sensitivity, GRPO exactly neutral, the three grade operators boundedly risk-seeking, MNL-exp unboundedly so. GRPO’s utility is affine, so it is exactly neutral in every column, this was also briefly shown empirically in Figure 2 . It says nothing about learning stability due to exploding variance however. One takeaway from Prop. 3 is that the grade-based operators are always boundedly risk-seeking due to being scale agnostic. For FTW the attractor is the elite threshold t = μ 0 + σ 0 ​ a C , K t=\mu_{0}+\sigma_{0}a_{C,K} . Mild filters with K K near C C have a C , K ≤ 0 a_{C,K}\leq 0 and put it at or below the buffer mean μ 0 \mu_{0} , DPO and the half filters K = C / 2 K=C/2 have a C , K = 0 a_{C,K}=0 and put it at the buffer mean exactly, and aggressive filters with K ≪ C K\ll C have a C , K > 0 a_{C,K}>0 and raise it above. The pull grows with the entry’s own σ \sigma but saturates at the attractor, so no amount of noise scores an entry above t t . MNL-exp uses the full return magnitude and is unboundedly risk-seeking, which also makes it fragile.

paragraphs.en: We close with limitations of this theoretical section. Firstly, the Arrow-Pratt expansion behind the FTW softmax-on-ranks row holds in the small-noise regime σ ≪ σ 0 \sigma\ll\sigma_{0} , which is not typically realistic, whereas the other rows hold at every σ \sigma . Secondly, the elite threshold T T is approximated by a normal to obtain a closed form, its exact law is skewed, so the FTW top- K K / C C cells are exact only in the pairwise Gaussian case. Thirdly, the buffer marginal is in general a mixture over conditional return laws, in practice these laws are not guaranteed homogenous. Our single-family assumption on F 0 F_{0} is thus a homogeneity idealization. Lastly, on sparse or stepwise rewards the grade operators admit no unique certainty equivalent, the 0 † 0^{\dagger} cells. On these discrete rewards they are also jackpot-blind, at a fixed mean m ​ p mp their weight for a rare large payoff collapses to that of a sure zero as p → 0 p\to 0 (which implies that the jackpot m m must grow), whereas MNL-exp instead diverges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以本理论部分的局限性作为结尾。 首先，FTW“基于排名的softmax”行背后的Arrow-Pratt展开在小噪声区域σ ≪ σ₀（σ远小于σ₀）中成立，而这种情况通常并不现实；相比之下，其他各行在所有σ值下均成立。 其次，精英阈值T是通过正态分布近似得到的闭式解，其精确分布是偏态的，因此FTW的top-K/C单元格仅在成对高斯情形下是精确的。 第三，缓冲区的边缘分布通常是条件回报分布的混合，而在实际中这些分布并不保证是同质的。 因此，我们对F₀的单家庭假设是一种同质性理想化。 最后，在稀疏或阶梯式奖励的情况下，等级算子不存在唯一的确定性等价，即0†单元格。 在这些离散奖励下，它们也对“头奖”不敏感：当p→0时，在固定均值mₚ下，稀有高额回报的权重会坍缩至确定零回报的权重（这意味着头奖m必须增长），而MNL-exp则会发散。

paragraphs.en: Our derivation provides a holistic account of two prominent RFT objectives. Both GRPO and DPO optimize a KL-regularized ELBO over trajectory batches under a Boltzmann likelihood. They differ in batch size ( N = 2 N=2 vs. N > 2 N>2 ) and choice of baseline (group-mean Jensen surrogate vs. exact pairwise normalizer). Within this framework, the apparent diversity of recent preference-optimization methods reduces to modeling choices on ℓ \ell , g g , β \beta , and the projection step, rather than to fundamentally different algorithmic principles. We do not claim a complete reduction of all such methods here. The framework is permissive enough to accommodate them, but the substantive recovery results are GRPO and DPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的推导对两个重要的 RFT 目标提供了全面的解释。 GRPO 和 DPO 都在玻尔兹曼似然下，针对轨迹批次优化一个经过 KL 正则化的 ELBO。 它们在批量大小（N = 2 N=2 与 N > 2 N>2）以及基线选择（组均值詹森替代函数与精确成对归一化器）上有所不同。 在此框架内，近期偏好优化方法的表面多样性实际上可归结为对 ℓ \ell、g g、β \beta 以及投影步骤的建模选择，而非源于根本不同的算法原理。 我们在此并不声称已将所有此类方法完全归约。 该框架足够灵活以容纳这些方法，但实质性的恢复结果仅涉及 GRPO 和 DPO。

paragraphs.en: This section describes our graphical model extension for the contextual-bandit study (see also Appendix G.4 ). We extend our control-as-inference formulation for batch potentials to deal with uncertainty given past data, and use our FTW approach to perform mirror descent in policy-space with a Gaussian belief. This structure enables closed form policy iteration, where each mirror-descent step extracts maximum value from past data given what the learning operator allows.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了我们为上下文多臂老虎机研究提出的图模型扩展（另见附录 G.4）。 我们将“控制即推理”的批量势函数框架进行扩展，以处理基于历史数据的不确定性，并利用我们的 FTW 方法在策略空间中结合高斯信念执行镜像下降。 这种结构支持闭式策略迭代，其中每个镜像下降步骤都能根据学习算子所允许的信息，从历史数据中提取最大价值。

paragraphs.en: the Bayesian learning rule of Khan and Rue (2023, Sec. 1.3.2) derived through our bound, matching their online Newton update with unit learning rate and, as in their conjugate-Bayes setting (their Sec. 5.1), the previous belief as the prior. The increments to the precision are positive semi-definite (Eq. ( 60 )), so the precision only accumulates and the effective step Λ t + 1 − 1 \Lambda_{t+1}^{-1} anneals as evidence arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 通过我们的界推导出的 Khan 和 Rue（2023，第 1.3.2 节）的贝叶斯学习规则，与他们的在线牛顿更新（使用单位学习率）一致，并且如同他们在共轭贝叶斯设定中（其第 5.1 节）一样，将先前的信念作为先验。精度的增量是半正定的（方程 (60)），因此精度只会不断累积，而有效步长 Λ t + 1 − 1 \Lambda_{t+1}^{-1} 会随着证据的到来而逐渐调整。

paragraphs.en: Note that the natural-parameter derivation placed the updated precision Λ t + 1 \Lambda_{t+1} in front of the mean update by itself, so the mean step accounts for the most recent evidence. This would not naturally occur if we derived the update through ( μ , Λ ) (\mu,\Lambda) directly. It is also the correct choice, since with Λ t + 1 \Lambda_{t+1} the update reproduces the exact Gaussian posterior whenever the loss is quadratic in W W , and with Λ t \Lambda_{t} it does not. The two derivatives of ℓ t \ell_{t} we need for computing Eq. ( 56 ) are derived next.

paragraphs.en: the potential applied to the belief-mixture of policies: each step pushes actions rolled out from a fresh posterior draw W ∼ q t W\sim q_{t} into the buffer, so uniform draws from the buffer sample the mixture over recent beliefs, and keeping tournament winners tilts those samples by Φ \Phi without evaluating it. The restriction only affects the variational gradient on the policy and the belief step itself is still solved exactly as in Eq. ( 56 ), just with a different tilt.
