paragraphs.zh: 应用于策略信念混合的潜在作用：每一步都将根据新的后验采样 W ∼ q t W\sim q_{t} 所展开的动作推入缓冲区，因此从缓冲区进行的均匀采样会采样近期的信念混合，而保留锦标赛获胜者则通过 Φ \Phi 对这些样本进行倾斜，而无需对其进行评估。随着信念的集中，这种倾斜与点态 q ∗ ( ⋅ ∣ W ) q^{*}(\cdot\mid W) 一致，且公式（56）中的更新保持不变。该限制仅影响策略上的变分梯度，而信念步本身仍像公式（56）中那样精确求解，只是采用了不同的倾斜方式。它同时也加强了公式（58）中高斯-牛顿的选择，因为 q ~ ∗ \tilde{q}^{*} 完全不携带 W W，因此 GGN 是精确的海森矩阵。

paragraphs.en: The three algorithms of main consideration in this manuscript correspond to different choices of the potential Φ \Phi through our theoretical framework. Within this construction, only GRPO cannot be interpreted as a probabilistic graphical model, due to the Jensen upper bound of Proposition 1 . This paragraph briefly summarizes how each potential produces its Hessian, and what decides it is not the potential itself but the route by which it enters the belief update: through the sampling of q ∗ q^{*} alone, through a closed-form loss that itself depends on W W , or through a bound that admits no likelihood. Throughout we apply the Gauss-Newton approximation, which guarantees positive semi-definite precision increments.
paragraphs.zh: 本手稿中主要考虑的三种算法，通过我们的理论框架对应于对势函数 Φ 的不同选择。 在此构建中，只有 GRPO 无法被解释为概率图模型，这是因为命题 1 中的詹森上界。 本段简要总结了每种势函数如何生成其黑森矩阵，并指出决定该矩阵的并非势函数本身，而是它进入信念更新的路径：仅通过 q^{*} 的采样、通过自身依赖于 W 的闭式损失，或通过一个不包含似然项的界。 在全文中，我们始终采用高斯-牛顿近似方法，该方法可确保精度增量为正半定矩阵。

paragraphs.en: Filtered cross-entropy. The potential Φ \Phi is the elite-filtering of Eq. ( 5 ), and FTW follows the derivation above literally: the potential enters only through the sampling of q ∗ q^{*} . The loss is therefore the cross-entropy against q ∗ q^{*} regardless of which Φ \Phi is in force, its exact Hessian is Eq. ( 60 ), and the Gauss-Newton step is FTW’s only approximation.
paragraphs.zh: 过滤交叉熵。势函数 Φ \Phi 是方程 (5) 中的精英过滤结果，而 FTW 严格遵循上述推导：该势函数仅通过 q ∗ q^{*} 的采样引入。因此，无论当前使用的是哪个 Φ \Phi，损失函数都是相对于 q ∗ q^{*} 的交叉熵；其精确的海森矩阵为方程 (60)，而高斯-牛顿步则是 FTW 唯一的近似方法。

paragraphs.en: Bradley-Terry. The potential compares one | ℬ N | = 2 |\mathcal{B}_{N}|=2 pair through the Plackett-Luce potential of Corollary 1 , but DPO does not take the route above: its potential is available in closed form and depends on W W itself, so DPO descends it directly rather than sampling q ∗ q^{*} . That loss is a log-sigmoid of the delta, − ln ⁡ σ ⁡ ( β ​ Δ ) -\ln\sigma(\beta\Delta) with Δ = ln ⁡ π W ​ ( a w ∣ x w ) − ln ⁡ π W ​ ( a l ∣ x l ) \Delta=\ln\pi_{W}(a_{w}\mid x_{w})-\ln\pi_{W}(a_{l}\mid x_{l}) the log-probability gap between winner and loser (the uniform reference policy cancels). Since Δ \Delta is nonlinear in W W , its exact Hessian is indefinite, and the Gauss-Newton step keeps only the positive semi-definite part, making the belief the posterior of the Bradley-Terry model linearized about the current mean ( Immer et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 布拉德利-泰瑞模型。 该势函数通过推论 1 中的普莱克特-卢斯势函数比较一个 |ℬ_N| = 2 |\mathcal{B}_{N}|=2 的配对，但 DPO 并未采用上述方法：其势函数具有闭式解且依赖于 W 本身，因此 DPO 会直接对其求下降，而非采样 q*。 该损失函数是 delta 的对数-sigmoid 函数，即 −lnσ(βΔ)，其中 Δ = lnπ_W(a_w|x_w) − lnπ_W(a_l|x_l) 是获胜者与失败者之间的对数概率差（均匀参考策略项被抵消）。 由于 Δ 关于 W 是非线性的，其精确的海森矩阵是不定的，因此高斯-牛顿步仅保留正半定部分，使信念成为围绕当前均值线性化的布拉德利-泰瑞模型的后验分布（Immer 等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Experiments were conducted across two cloud providers. Bandit, Brax, and Search-R1 experiments ran on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using a2-highgpu-1g (1 × \times NVIDIA A100-40GB, 12 vCPUs, 85 GB RAM, Intel Xeon Cascade Lake), a2-ultragpu-1g (1 × \times NVIDIA A100-80GB, 12 vCPUs, 170 GB RAM, Intel Xeon Cascade Lake), and a3-highgpu-1g (1 × \times NVIDIA H100-80GB, 26 vCPUs, 234 GB RAM, Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids), each with 500 GB SSD persistent disk. The 40GB A100s were sufficient only to host the Search-R1 retrieval server (our own simplified faiss-index implementation to sidestep a bug in the base implementation that caused VRAM overheads), all other agents ran on the 80GB A100s or the H100. paragraphs.en: We briefly compare the computational footprint of FTW against GRPO, PPO, and REINFORCE++ on three items, data generation, the learning update, and memory. For data generation, all four methods consume the same number of rollouts per step in our Sokoban runs, but GRPO must obtain them as n n rollouts of the same prompt, which requires resetting the environment to identical initial states, whereas FTW, PPO, and REINFORCE++ draw one rollout per prompt. Prefix caching can offset part of the group overhead, but the duplication requirement remains. The learning updates differ negligibly in cost apart from the critic. FTW performs a cross-entropy loss on the filtered samples plus a KL penalty, GRPO and REINFORCE++ add PPO-style clipping and advantage normalization, and PPO additionally trains a second model of the same size as the policy, which incurs a further forward and backward pass per update. In our Sokoban runs this meant 4 GPUs for PPO against 2 for GRPO and REINFORCE++ and 1 to 2 for FTW. In terms of storage, FTW is the most expensive because of the replay buffer of past rollouts, 2,000 trajectories on Sokoban and 10,000 on Search-R1, held in CPU memory, whereas the other three methods are on-policy. The overhead depends on the data modality, text environments such as Search-R1 have a far smaller footprint per trajectory than image-based ones such as Sokoban. GRPO extended with a replay buffer, as done by Arnal et al. (2026) , would match FTW’s memory footprint, leaving the group duplication as the remaining difference. REINFORCE++ is the cheapest on every axis and is also the method that lags in Figure 4 , which is what motivates paying for one of the three variance-reduction sources.
paragraphs.zh: 我们简要比较了 FTW 与 GRPO、PPO 和 REINFORCE++ 在三项指标上的计算开销：数据生成、学习更新和内存。在数据生成方面，在我们进行的 Sokoban 实验中，这四种方法每一步消耗的 rollout 数量相同，但 GRPO 必须将这些 rollout 以 n 个相同提示的 rollout 形式获取，这需要将环境重置到完全相同的初始状态；而 FTW、PPO 和 REINFORCE++ 则每个提示仅生成一个 rollout。前缀缓存可以抵消部分群体计算的额外开销，但重复生成的要求仍然存在。除了批评模型（critic）之外，学习更新的成本差异微乎其微。FTW 对过滤后的样本执行交叉熵损失计算，并附加 KL 惩罚项；GRPO 和 REINFORCE++ 则增加了 PPO 风格的裁剪和优势归一化；PPO 还额外训练了一个与策略模型大小相同的第二模型，这会在每次更新时产生一次额外的前向和反向传播。在我们的 Sokoban 实验中，这意味着 PPO 需要 4 块 GPU，而 GRPO 和 REINFORCE++ 需要 2 块，FTW 则需要 1 到 2 块。在存储方面，FTW 的开销最大，因为它需要存储过往 rollout 的重播缓冲区：在 Sokoban 上为 2,000 条轨迹，在 Search-R1 上为 10,000 条，且这些数据都存储在 CPU 内存中；而其他三种方法均为在线策略方法。额外开销取决于数据模态：像 Search-R1 这样的文本环境，每条轨迹的开销远小于像 Sokoban 这样的图像环境。如果像 Arnal 等人（2026）那样为 GRPO 添加重播缓冲区，其内存占用将与 FTW 相当，此时唯一的差异将来自群体的重复生成。REINFORCE++ 在所有维度上的开销都最低，但它也是图 4 中表现最差的方法，这正说明有必要采用这三种方差减少方法之一。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments span four distinct environments: Bandits, Brax continuous control, Search-R1, and Sokoban. Each environment required a separate software stack and varying setup, for three main reasons. First, packaging conflicts : the verl-agent fork we build on ( Feng et al., 2025 ) lags upstream verl and pins torch 2.8.0+cu128 / vLLM 0.11.0 . Sokoban requires the legacy gym 0.26.2 API (via gym-sokoban ), which conflicts with the gymnasium -based stack used elsewhere. Second, hardware heterogeneity across providers : we ran on a mix of A100-40GB, A100-80GB, and H100-80GB instances (see Appendix G.1 ), and VRAM size materially changed configuration. Third, model choices dictated by baseline parity and modality : Search-R1 uses Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct to match the scale reported in prior work, and Sokoban uses the vision-language Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct to consume the RGB puzzle rendering directly. The Brax environments were fortunately much simpler, as they only required a small MLP provided by the reference implementation of Freeman et al. (2021) . All cloud runs share Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, Python 3.12.3, NVIDIA driver 570.211.01, and set NCCL_NET=Socket . This socket setting made our runs slower, but it was required due to GCP-related issues. Table 2 lists the key package versions per environment. For more specific details, we advise the reader to look at the verl-agent documentation https://github.com/langfengQ/verl-agent which has extensive documentation for the environment setup.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验涵盖了四个不同的环境：Bandits、Brax 连续控制、Search-R1 和 Sokoban。 每个环境都需要独立的软件堆栈和不同的配置，这主要有三个原因。 首先，是打包冲突：我们构建的 verl-agent 分支（Feng 等人，2025）落后于上游 verl，并固定使用了 torch 2.8.0+cu128 / vLLM 0.11.0。 Sokoban 需要旧版 gym 0.26.2 API（通过 gym-sokoban），这与其他地方使用的基于 gymnasium 的堆栈存在冲突。 其次，不同提供商之间的硬件异构性：我们在 A100-40GB、A100-80GB 和 H100-80GB 实例的组合上运行（参见附录 G.1），显存大小显著影响了配置。 第三，模型的选择由基线一致性和模态决定：Search-R1 使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 以匹配先前工作报道的规模，而 Sokoban 则使用视觉语言模型 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 直接处理 RGB 拼图渲染。 幸运的是，Brax 环境要简单得多，因为它们只需要 Freeman 等人（2021）参考实现中提供的小型 MLP。 所有云端运行都共享 Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS、Python 3.12.3、NVIDIA 驱动 570.211.01，并设置了 NCCL_NET=Socket。 这种套接字设置使我们的运行速度变慢，但由于与 GCP 相关的问题，这是必要的。 表 2 列出了每个环境的关键包版本。 如需更具体的细节，我们建议读者查阅 verl-agent 文档 https://github.com/langfengQ/verl-agent，其中包含有关环境设置的详尽说明。

paragraphs.en: Search-R1 ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . Multi-turn open-domain QA with a retrieval tool, framed as a POMDP where the agent alternates between internal reasoning and tool invocation until it commits to an answer. At each turn the prompt contains the question and the interaction history, where prior search queries and the retrieved passages are interleaved as <search>...</search> and <information>...</information> blocks. The LLM emits chain-of-thought inside <think>...</think> and then chooses exactly one of two actions: a new query in <search>...</search> (control returns to the retriever) or a final answer in <answer>...</answer> (terminating the episode). Emitting both or neither consumes a turn. Retrieved passages are obtained by dense lookup against an E5 index of the Wikipedia-18 corpus ( wiki-18.jsonl , 14 GB) compressed from a 61 GB flat index to an 815 MB IVF-PQ index ( e5_IVFPQ.index ) and served from a dedicated retrieval venv on port 8000, returning the top-3 passages per query. Reward is an exact-match indicator on the final answer against the gold label, with an additional − 0.1 -0.1 penalty for malformed emissions (missing or duplicate action tags). Train set: 169,615 questions from PeterJinGo/nq_hotpotqa_train (a mix of Natural Questions and HotpotQA). Test set, on which the main-text accuracies are computed, is the 51,713-question eval set bundled with the same release, drawn from NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, Musique, and Bamboogle. Training-time curves use a fixed 1,280-question slice of it. Max turns: 4. Prompt/response budgets: 4,096 / 512 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: Search-R1（Jin 等人，2025）。 多轮开放域问答任务中使用检索工具，该任务被建模为 POMDP，其中智能体在内部推理和工具调用之间交替进行，直到最终确定答案。 每一轮提示都包含问题和交互历史，其中先前的搜索查询和检索到的段落以 <search>...</search> 和 <information>...</information> 块交错呈现。 LLM 会在 <think>...</think> 内部生成思维链，然后从两个动作中精确选择一个：在 <search>...</search> 中发起新查询（控制权返回检索器），或在 <answer>...</answer> 中给出最终答案（结束本轮交互）。 同时或不同时发出这两种操作都会消耗一轮交互。 检索到的段落通过密集检索从 Wikipedia-18 语料库的 E5 索引（wiki-18.jsonl，14 GB）获取；该索引由一个 61 GB 的扁平索引压缩为 815 MB 的 IVF-PQ 索引（e5_IVFPQ.index），并通过端口 8000 上的专用检索虚拟环境提供服务，每次查询返回前 3 个相关段落。 奖励基于最终答案与标准标签是否完全匹配进行判断，并对格式错误的输出（缺少或重复的动作标签）额外扣除 0.1 分。 训练集：来自 PeterJinGo/nq_hotpotqa_train 的 169,615 个问题（包含 Natural Questions 和 HotpotQA 的混合数据）。 测试集用于计算正文中的准确率，包含该发布版本附带的 51,713 个问题的评估集，数据来源于 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、Musique 和 Bamboogle。 训练阶段的曲线使用其中固定的 1,280 个问题切片。最大轮数：4。 提示/响应配额：4,096 / 512 个词元。

sents.zh: Search-R1（Jin 等人，2025）。

sents.en: Multi-turn open-domain QA with a retrieval tool, framed as a POMDP where the agent alternates between internal reasoning and tool invocation until it commits to an answer.
sents.zh: 多轮开放域问答任务中使用检索工具，该任务被建模为 POMDP，其中智能体在内部推理和工具调用之间交替进行，直到最终确定答案。

sents.en: At each turn the prompt contains the question and the interaction history, where prior search queries and the retrieved passages are interleaved as <search>...</search> and <information>...</information> blocks.
sents.zh: 每一轮提示都包含问题和交互历史，其中先前的搜索查询和检索到的段落以 <search>...</search> 和 <information>...</information> 块交错呈现。

sents.en: The LLM emits chain-of-thought inside <think>...</think> and then chooses exactly one of two actions: a new query in <search>...</search> (control returns to the retriever) or a final answer in <answer>...</answer> (terminating the episode).
sents.zh: LLM 会在 <think>...</think> 内部生成思维链，然后从两个动作中精确选择一个：在 <search>...</search> 中发起新查询（控制权返回检索器），或在 <answer>...</answer> 中给出最终答案（结束本轮交互）。

sents.en: Emitting both or neither consumes a turn.
sents.zh: 同时或不同时发出这两种操作都会消耗一轮交互。

sents.en: Retrieved passages are obtained by dense lookup against an E5 index of the Wikipedia-18 corpus ( wiki-18.jsonl , 14 GB) compressed from a 61 GB flat index to an 815 MB IVF-PQ index ( e5_IVFPQ.index ) and served from a dedicated retrieval venv on port 8000, returning the top-3 passages per query.
sents.zh: 检索到的段落通过密集检索从 Wikipedia-18 语料库的 E5 索引（wiki-18.jsonl，14 GB）获取；该索引由一个 61 GB 的扁平索引压缩为 815 MB 的 IVF-PQ 索引（e5_IVFPQ.index），并通过端口 8000 上的专用检索虚拟环境提供服务，每次查询返回前 3 个相关段落。

sents.en: Reward is an exact-match indicator on the final answer against the gold label, with an additional − 0.1 -0.1 penalty for malformed emissions (missing or duplicate action tags).
sents.zh: 奖励基于最终答案与标准标签是否完全匹配进行判断，并对格式错误的输出（缺少或重复的动作标签）额外扣除 0.1 分。

sents.en: Train set: 169,615 questions from PeterJinGo/nq_hotpotqa_train (a mix of Natural Questions and HotpotQA).
sents.zh: 训练集：来自 PeterJinGo/nq_hotpotqa_train 的 169,615 个问题（包含 Natural Questions 和 HotpotQA 的混合数据）。

sents.en: Test set, on which the main-text accuracies are computed, is the 51,713-question eval set bundled with the same release, drawn from NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, Musique, and Bamboogle.
sents.zh: 测试集用于计算正文中的准确率，包含该发布版本附带的 51,713 个问题的评估集，数据来源于 NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、Musique 和 Bamboogle。

sents.en: Training-time curves use a fixed 1,280-question slice of it. Max turns: 4.
sents.zh: 训练阶段的曲线使用其中固定的 1,280 个问题切片。最大轮数：4。

sents.en: Prompt/response budgets: 4,096 / 512 tokens.
sents.zh: 提示/响应配额：4,096 / 512 个词元。

paragraphs.en: Sokoban ( Schrader, 2018 ) . Vision-language box-pushing puzzle ( gym_sokoban ) on a 6 × \times 6 grid with one box and a generator search depth of 30 (the num_gen_steps parameter controlling puzzle complexity at instantiation, not the per-episode horizon). At each turn the environment’s rgb_array rendering is supplied to the policy as an image via data.image_key=images , alongside the textual task description and a short history of prior actions. The vision-language model emits chain-of-thought inside <think>...</think> followed by a single direction in <action>...</action> , with admissible set {up, down, left, right}. Each direction is dispatched as the corresponding Push action in gym_sokoban , and unparsable or illegal emissions consume a turn. Rewards follow the gym_sokoban defaults: − 0.1 -0.1 per step, ± 1 \pm 1 on pushing the box on/off its target, and + 10 +10 upon solving, with an additional − 0.1 -0.1 format penalty consistent with the main text. Train/validation split: 32 / 128 puzzles. Episode horizon: 15 turns. Prompt/response budgets: 1,024 / 512 tokens, with image tokens accounted for separately by the VLM processor and not counted against the prompt budget.
paragraphs.zh: Sokoban（Schrader，2018）。 在 6 × 6 的网格上运行的视觉-语言推箱谜题（gym_sokoban），包含一个箱子，生成器搜索深度为 30（num_gen_steps 参数用于控制实例化时的谜题复杂度，而非每轮次的时间上限）。 在每个回合中，环境通过 data.image_key=images 将渲染出的 rgb_array 作为图像提供给策略，同时附带文本任务描述和先前动作的简短历史记录。 视觉-语言模型在 </think> 内部生成思维链，随后输出一个位于 <action>...</action> 中的单一方向，允许的动作集合为 {上、下、左、右}。 每个方向都会被派发给 gym_sokoban 中对应的“推”动作；无法解析或非法的输出将消耗一个回合。 奖励遵循 gym_sokoban 的默认设置：每步 −0.1，将箱子推至目标位置或移出目标位置时获得 ±1，完成谜题时获得 +10，此外还有一项与正文一致的 −0.1 格式惩罚。 训练/验证划分：32 / 128 个谜题。 轮次上限：15 回合。 提示/响应配额：1,024 / 512 个词元，其中图像词元由 VLM 处理器单独计算，不计入提示配额。

paragraphs.en: For both Search-R1 and Sokoban, all settings in Table 4 are shared across all tested algorithms. The replay buffer size is listed at the bottom of Table 4 . GRPO replaces FTW’s elite filtering with group-relative advantages over n n rollouts per prompt, combined with a PPO-clip objective rather than the cross-entropy SFT loss. PPO replaces the group baseline with a learned critic, a second Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct initialised from the base model and trained at lr 10 − 5 10^{-5} with value clipping 0.5 0.5 , using GAE with λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 and γ = 1 \gamma{=}1 so the advantage is the Monte-Carlo return minus the value estimate. REINFORCE++ ( Hu et al., 2025 ) keeps a single rollout per prompt and normalises returns by the global batch mean and standard deviation, with the same PPO-clip objective, KL penalty, and entropy coefficient as GRPO. Both baselines run directly through the verl-agent implementation ( Feng et al., 2025 ) by switching its advantage estimator, with all other settings held fixed. The FTW configurations differ only in the minibatch size C C and the number of elites per minibatch K K . On Search-R1 we use C = 4 C{=}4 with K = 1 K{=}1 , and on Sokoban C = 5 C{=}5 with K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } K\in\{1,2,3\} retained trajectories, sweeping from strong to weak selection pressure. The limiting case C = 2 C{=}2 , K = 1 K{=}1 is binary selection, which coincides with DPO’s pairwise potential and is not run here. For all FTW configurations, the number of minibatches per gradient step J J is set proportional to K K such that each update receives J ⋅ K J\cdot K training targets at a fixed effective batch size. The cross-environment differences in Table 4 (e.g. KL coefficient, discount γ \gamma ) are inherited from the published baseline settings for each benchmark rather than tuned for FTW. Default system prompts for the LLMs are kept at their default values as provided by the packages pinned in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Search-R1 和 Sokoban，表 4 中的所有设置均在所有测试算法中共享。 重播缓冲区的大小列于表 4 的底部。 GRPO 用每次提示 n 次 rollout 的组相对优势替代了 FTW 的精英筛选，并结合了 PPO-clip 目标函数，而非交叉熵 SFT 损失。 PPO 用一个学习到的批评者替代了组基线；该批评者是第二个 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 模型，初始化为基础模型，并以学习率 10^{-5}、价值裁剪 0.5 进行训练，使用 GAE（其中 λ = 1，γ = 1），因此优势为蒙特卡洛回报减去价值估计值。 REINFORCE++（Hu et al., 2025）每次提示仅保留一次 rollout，并通过全局批均值和标准差对回报进行归一化，同时使用与 GRPO 相同的 PPO-clip 目标函数、KL 惩罚项和熵系数。 两种基线方法均通过切换 verl-agent 实现（Feng et al., 2025）中的优势估计器直接运行，其他所有设置保持不变。 FTW 的配置仅在小批量大小 C 和每个小批量的精英数量 K 上有所不同。 在 Search-R1 中，我们使用 C = 4、K = 1；在 Sokoban 中，使用 C = 5，并保留 K ∈ {1, 2, 3} 条轨迹，以从强到弱扫描选择压力。 极限情况 C = 2、K = 1 是二元选择，这与 DPO 的成对势一致，因此在此未运行。 对于所有 FTW 配置，每个梯度步骤的小批量数量 J 被设置为与 K 成正比，使得每次更新都能以固定的有效批量大小获得 J ⋅ K 个训练目标。 表 4 中的跨环境差异（例如： KL 系数、折扣因子 γ）继承自每个基准测试已发布的基线设置，而非为 FTW 单独调整。 LLM 的默认系统提示保持为表 2 中指定包提供的默认值。

paragraphs.en: This appendix collects results that complement the main paper. Section H.1 reports in-distribution learning curves for the LLM-agent experiments (test-time curves appear in the main text, Figure 4 ). Section H.2 dissects the FTW selection operator on the σ \sigma -trap, grading the polynomial filter by selection pressure and sweeping the temperature of an exponential-rank alternative. Section H.3 extends the Pareto- α \alpha sweep of Figure 2 to four additional return distributions, isolating which features of the return distribution drive the failure mode of cardinal-exponential potentials. Section H.4 expands the state-aliasing experiment with a learning-rate sweep, showing that the polynomial-vs-exponential concentration gap is not an artifact of a single learning rate (which dampens learning instability). Section H.5 identifies a solution bias of elite filtering over the replay buffer when returns saturate and comparisons are dominated by ties, complementing the robustness results above with the adversarial regime of the rank-based potential.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录收集了补充主论文结果的研究成果。 H.1 节报告了 LLM-智能体实验的分布内学习曲线（测试时的曲线见正文第 4 图）。 H.2 节分析了 FTW 选择算子在 σ \sigma -陷阱上的表现，通过选择压力对多项式滤波器进行分级，并扫描了指数排名替代方案的温度参数。 H.3 节将图 2 中的 Pareto-α \alpha 扫描扩展至另外四种回报分布，从而明确回报分布的哪些特征会导致基数-指数势能的失效模式。 H.4 节通过学习率扫描扩展了状态别名实验，表明多项式与指数之间的集中差异并非单一学习率（该学习率会抑制学习不稳定性）所导致的人为现象。 H.5 节指出，当回报饱和且比较主要由平局主导时，精英筛选在重播缓冲区中存在解决方案偏差，从而从对抗性排名势能的视角补充了上述的鲁棒性结果。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows success rates on training episodes that complement the test-time evaluations in the main text. On Sokoban (left), our FTW-K1-C5 and FTW-K2-C5 and the GRPO and PPO baselines cluster almost indistinguishably together, whereas REINFORCE++ trains markedly slower and with larger seed variance. In contrast, our FTW-K3-C5 peaks on average near 0.4 0.4 and then collapses to zero. This collapse can partly be attributed to Sokoban’s effectively binary returns. Whenever a group contains fewer than K K successes the remaining elite slots are always filled with zeros, and such groups are far more common at K = 3 K{=}3 than at K = 1 K{=}1 , where one success out of C C already suffices. Although the imitated elite threshold still averages above the buffer mean in expectation (Appendix 3 ), the share of imitated zeros grows as the success rate falls and this drags each consecutive update further down. Ultimately this is a finite-sample effect rather than a flaw in the operator, a larger replay buffer would smooth the K3 curve out at the cost of slower learning. On Search-R1 (right), FTW-K1-C4 dips slightly during initial training, and then steadily improves. Note that the training success rate is not directly comparable to the test success rate, due to the validation set only covering NQ and HotpotQA questions.
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了训练回合的成功率，这些数据补充了正文中测试时的评估结果。 在Sokoban（左侧）上，我们的FTW-K1-C5和FTW-K2-C5与GRPO及PPO基线模型几乎无法区分地聚集在一起，而REINFORCE++的训练速度明显更慢，且种子方差更大。 相比之下，我们的FTW-K3-C5平均峰值接近0.4 0.4，随后则骤降至零。 这种崩溃部分归因于Sokoban实际上具有二元回报的特性。 每当一个组包含的成功数少于K K时，剩余的精英名额总是由零填充；而在K = 3 K{=}3的情况下，这类组比K = 1 K{=}1时要常见得多，因为后者只需C C中的一个成功即可满足条件。 尽管模仿的精英阈值在期望上仍然高于缓冲区的平均值（附录3），但随着成功率下降，被模仿的零的比例会增大，这会将每次连续更新进一步拉低。 最终来看，这是一个有限样本效应，而非算子本身的缺陷；使用更大的重播缓冲区可以平滑K3曲线，但代价是学习速度变慢。 在Search-R1（右侧）上，FTW-K1-C4在初始训练期间略有下降，随后则稳步提升。 请注意，由于验证集仅覆盖NQ和HotpotQA问题，训练成功率与测试成功率并不直接可比。

paragraphs.en: Extending upon Figure 2 (left) we provide more examples of the FTW filtering pressure on the σ \sigma -trap in Figure 6 . All variants share the identical backbone of FTW, they only differ in how the filtering (winner selection) is applied to the replay buffer. As in the main text, results are averaged over buffer sizes h ∈ { 16 , 64 , 256 , 1024 , 4096 } h\in\{16,64,256,1024,4096\} for FTW-polynomial and with h ∈ { 16 , 64 } h\in\{16,64\} for the exponential filtering on the ranking, as FTW-exp requires sorting the entire replay buffer, which gets expensive. Note that the FTW-exp-marg from the main text (Fig. 2 ) filtered using a softmax over the buffer returns, whereas this experiments uses a multinomial over their ordered rank (argsort index) for a given temperature τ \tau . This was done to eliminate the ordinal vs. marginal confounding argument of our FTW operator.
paragraphs.zh: 在图2（左）的基础上，我们在图6中提供了更多关于FTW对σ陷阱的过滤压力的示例。 所有变体都共享相同的FTW主干结构，它们仅在将过滤（获胜者选择）应用于重播缓冲区的方式上有所不同。 与正文中的情况一样，对于FTW-多项式模型，结果是在缓冲区大小 h ∈ {16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096} 上取平均的；而对于排名上的指数过滤模型，则使用 h ∈ {16, 64}，因为FTW-指数模型需要对整个重播缓冲区进行排序，这会带来较大的计算开销。 请注意，正文中的FTW-exp-marg（图2）是使用对缓冲区回报的softmax函数进行过滤的，而本实验则针对给定的温度τ，使用基于其有序排名（argsort索引）的多项分布进行过滤。 这样做是为了消除我们FTW算子中序数与边际性之间的混淆问题。

paragraphs.en: The polynomial selection (red lines, Figure 6 ) are determined by the selection pressure C / K \nicefrac{{C}}{{K}} . We see for a mild C = 4 , K = 3 C{=}4,K{=}3 filter that the risk-profile stays minimal, even at larger σ \sigma . In contrast the more aggressive C = 4 , K = 1 C{=}4,K{=}1 filter collapses onto the trap arm, as suspected. For the exponential-ordinal filter, we see that the greedy limit τ → 0 \tau\to 0 (buffer argmax) collapses onto the trap even swifter than the aggressive polynomial configuration. Unsurprisingly, the other extreme τ → ∞ \tau\rightarrow\infty stays constant to its 1/2 prior. The temperatures inbetween τ ∈ { 0.01 , 1.0 , 100.0 } \tau\in\{0.01,1.0,100.0\} form a type of U-curve that finds the optimal arm for moderate or low noise (temp = 1.0) before interpolating back to uniform for large τ \tau or back to the overly aggressive τ = 0 \tau=0 version.
paragraphs.zh: 多项式选择（红色线条，图6）由选择压力 C/K \nicefrac{{C}}{{K}} 决定。 对于较温和的 C = 4、K = 3 的滤波器，我们观察到即使 σ 较大，风险轮廓仍能保持最小。 相比之下，更具攻击性的 C = 4、K = 1 的滤波器如预期般坍缩到陷阱臂上。 对于指数序数滤波器，我们观察到贪心极限 τ → 0（缓冲区 argmax）比攻击性多项式配置更快地坍缩到陷阱上。 不出所料，另一个极端情况 τ → ∞ 则保持与其先验值 1/2 不变。 介于两者之间的温度 τ ∈ {0.01, 1.0, 100.0} 形成一种U型曲线：在中等或低噪声条件下（温度 = 1.0）找到最优臂，随后在 τ 很大时插值回均匀分布，或在 τ = 0 时回到过于攻击性的版本。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 extends the Pareto- α \alpha sweep of Figure 2 (center) to four additional return distributions. The five rows isolate distinct features of the return distribution and check whether the theoretical risk profile of Proposition 2 predicts the empirical failure modes correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 将图 2（中部）的帕累托-α \alpha 扫描扩展到了另外四种回报分布。 这五行分别展示了回报分布的不同特征，并检验了命题 2 的理论风险特征能否正确预测经验中的失效模式。

sents.en: Figure 7 extends the Pareto- α \alpha sweep of Figure 2 (center) to four additional return distributions.
sents.zh: 图 7 将图 2（中部）的帕累托-α \alpha 扫描扩展到了另外四种回报分布。

sents.en: The five rows isolate distinct features of the return distribution and check whether the theoretical risk profile of Proposition 2 predicts the empirical failure modes correctly.
sents.zh: 这五行分别展示了回报分布的不同特征，并检验了命题 2 的理论风险特征能否正确预测经验中的失效模式。

paragraphs.en: Beta ( κ \kappa shape). Bounded support, where varying κ \kappa moves between U-shaped, uniform, and bell-shaped returns. All three methods solve the bandit, and FTW shows slightly faster scale-regret reduction in the early phase. As expected, no method is destabilized when returns are bounded, regardless of shape.
paragraphs.zh: Beta（κ \kappa 形状）。 支持集有界，其中变化的 κ \kappa 会在 U 形、均匀和钟形回报之间转换。 所有三种方法都能解决该多臂老虎机问题，且 FTW 在早期阶段表现出略微更快的规模-遗憾度下降。 正如预期的那样，当回报有界时，无论其形状如何，没有任何方法会失稳。

sents.en: Beta ( κ \kappa shape).
sents.zh: Beta（κ \kappa 形状）。

sents.en: Bounded support, where varying κ \kappa moves between U-shaped, uniform, and bell-shaped returns.
sents.zh: 支持集有界，其中变化的 κ \kappa 会在 U 形、均匀和钟形回报之间转换。

sents.en: All three methods solve the bandit, and FTW shows slightly faster scale-regret reduction in the early phase.
sents.zh: 所有三种方法都能解决该多臂老虎机问题，且 FTW 在早期阶段表现出略微更快的规模-遗憾度下降。

sents.en: As expected, no method is destabilized when returns are bounded, regardless of shape.
sents.zh: 正如预期的那样，当回报有界时，无论其形状如何，没有任何方法会失稳。

paragraphs.en: Binomial. The clean sparsity sweep. All three methods identify the optimal arm. GRPO converges visibly slower than the rank-based methods at low p p , consistent with its cardinal treatment of returns under sparse signals.
paragraphs.zh: 二项式。 干净的稀疏性扫描。 所有三种方法都能识别出最优臂。 在低 p p 条件下，GRPO 的收敛速度明显慢于基于排名的方法，这与它在稀疏信号下对回报的基本处理方式一致。

sents.en: Binomial.
sents.zh: 二项式。

sents.en: The clean sparsity sweep.
sents.zh: 干净的稀疏性扫描。

sents.en: All three methods identify the optimal arm.
sents.zh: 所有三种方法都能识别出最优臂。

sents.en: GRPO converges visibly slower than the rank-based methods at low p p , consistent with its cardinal treatment of returns under sparse signals.
sents.zh: 在低 p p 条件下，GRPO 的收敛速度明显慢于基于排名的方法，这与它在稀疏信号下对回报的基本处理方式一致。

paragraphs.en: Binomial scaled ( × 1000 \times 1000 ). The same Bernoulli-rate sweep with rewards scaled by 1000 1000 , isolating magnitude robustness from sparsity. GRPO’s curves remain bounded but the slow-convergence gap at low p p widens substantially under the scale. FTW and DPO are scale-invariant by construction (rank-based), and their curves overlap their unscaled counterparts. This confirms that magnitude (not sparsity per se) is the destabilizing factor for the cardinal baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 二项式缩放（× 1000 \times 1000）。 采用相同的伯努利率扫描，但将奖励缩放 1000 倍，从而将幅度鲁棒性与稀疏性分离。 GRPO 的曲线仍然有界，但在低 p 值下，由于缩放效应，缓慢收敛的差距显著扩大。 FTW 和 DPO 因其基于排名的构造而具有尺度不变性，其曲线与未缩放的对应曲线重叠。 这证实了幅度（而非稀疏性本身）是导致基线模型不稳定的关键因素。

sents.en: Binomial scaled ( × 1000 \times 1000 ).
sents.zh: 二项式缩放（× 1000 \times 1000）。

sents.en: The same Bernoulli-rate sweep with rewards scaled by 1000 1000 , isolating magnitude robustness from sparsity.
sents.zh: 采用相同的伯努利率扫描，但将奖励缩放 1000 倍，从而将幅度鲁棒性与稀疏性分离。

sents.en: GRPO’s curves remain bounded but the slow-convergence gap at low p p widens substantially under the scale.
sents.zh: GRPO 的曲线仍然有界，但在低 p 值下，由于缩放效应，缓慢收敛的差距显著扩大。

sents.en: FTW and DPO are scale-invariant by construction (rank-based), and their curves overlap their unscaled counterparts.
sents.zh: FTW 和 DPO 因其基于排名的构造而具有尺度不变性，其曲线与未缩放的对应曲线重叠。

sents.en: This confirms that magnitude (not sparsity per se) is the destabilizing factor for the cardinal baseline.
sents.zh: 这证实了幅度（而非稀疏性本身）是导致基线模型不稳定的关键因素。

paragraphs.en: Pareto- α \alpha . Reproduces the main-text result for the non-truncated version of the distribution. GRPO fails to identify the optimal arm at heavy-tail α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 , where the moment-generating function diverges. FTW and DPO remain stable, as predicted by the rank-based potentials’ well-defined fixed point under any continuous return distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 帕累托- α \alpha 。 复现了分布非截断版本在主文中的结果。 在重尾 α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 的情况下，GRPO 无法识别出最优臂，此时矩生成函数发散。 FTW 和 DPO 保持稳定，正如基于排名的势函数在任何连续回报分布下都具有明确定义的固定点所预测的那样。

sents.en: Pareto- α \alpha .
sents.zh: 帕累托- α \alpha 。

sents.en: Reproduces the main-text result for the non-truncated version of the distribution.
sents.zh: 复现了分布非截断版本在主文中的结果。

sents.en: GRPO fails to identify the optimal arm at heavy-tail α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 , where the moment-generating function diverges.
sents.zh: 在重尾 α ≤ 1 \alpha\leq 1 的情况下，GRPO 无法识别出最优臂，此时矩生成函数发散。

sents.en: FTW and DPO remain stable, as predicted by the rank-based potentials’ well-defined fixed point under any continuous return distribution.
sents.zh: FTW 和 DPO 保持稳定，正如基于排名的势函数在任何连续回报分布下都具有明确定义的固定点所预测的那样。

paragraphs.en: Student- t t ( ν \nu ). Symmetric, polynomially-tailed distribution on ℝ \mathbb{R} . At ν ≤ 2 \nu\leq 2 the variance of returns becomes undefined, and GRPO’s group-mean baseline destabilizes accordingly, with scale-regret curves drifting noticeably. FTW and DPO remain unaffected, since the rank-based potential depends only on the order statistic. This confirms that the destabilization of GRPO under heavy tails is not specific to the one-sided support of Pareto.
paragraphs.zh: 学生- t t ( ν \nu )。 在 ℝ \mathbb{R} 上的对称、多项式尾分布。 当 ν ≤ 2 \nu\leq 2 时，回报的方差变为未定义，GRPO 的组均值基线也随之变得不稳定，其规模遗憾曲线出现明显漂移。 FTW 和 DPO 不受影响，因为基于排名的势仅取决于顺序统计量。 这证实了 GRPO 在重尾分布下不稳定的现象并非帕累托分布单侧支撑所特有。

sents.en: Student- t t ( ν \nu ).
sents.zh: 学生- t t ( ν \nu )。

sents.en: Symmetric, polynomially-tailed distribution on ℝ \mathbb{R} .
sents.zh: 在 ℝ \mathbb{R} 上的对称、多项式尾分布。

sents.en: At ν ≤ 2 \nu\leq 2 the variance of returns becomes undefined, and GRPO’s group-mean baseline destabilizes accordingly, with scale-regret curves drifting noticeably.
sents.zh: 当 ν ≤ 2 \nu\leq 2 时，回报的方差变为未定义，GRPO 的组均值基线也随之变得不稳定，其规模遗憾曲线出现明显漂移。

sents.en: FTW and DPO remain unaffected, since the rank-based potential depends only on the order statistic.
sents.zh: FTW 和 DPO 不受影响，因为基于排名的势仅取决于顺序统计量。

sents.en: This confirms that the destabilization of GRPO under heavy tails is not specific to the one-sided support of Pareto.
sents.zh: 这证实了 GRPO 在重尾分布下不稳定的现象并非帕累托分布单侧支撑所特有。

paragraphs.en: Across all five rows, the rank-based potentials never destabilize, while GRPO destabilizes precisely in the regimes where the moment-generating function diverges. This matches the prediction of Proposition 2 . The cardinal-exponential potential has an undefined fixed point under heavy tails, while rank-based potentials depend only on the order statistic and are insensitive to tail behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有五行中，基于排名的势函数从未失稳，而 GRPO 恰恰在矩生成函数发散的区域出现失稳。 这与命题 2 的预测一致。 在重尾分布下，基数指数势函数存在一个未定义的固定点，而基于排名的势函数仅依赖于顺序统计量，对尾部行为不敏感。

sents.en: Across all five rows, the rank-based potentials never destabilize, while GRPO destabilizes precisely in the regimes where the moment-generating function diverges.

paragraphs.en: The key takeaway is that tie-breaking is inherent to any RL algorithm on saturated rewards, but the ordinal tilting of methods like FTW induces different learning dynamics than typical marginal methods. The results present a buffer-size trade-off: larger buffers reduce selection noise and in expectation resolve ties through more accurate non-parametric estimation, at the cost of smoothing and slower policy movement.
paragraphs.zh: 关键结论是，在奖励饱和的情况下，任何强化学习算法都不可避免地存在破平问题，但像 FTW 这类方法通过序数倾斜所引发的学习动态，与典型的边际方法截然不同。 研究结果揭示了缓冲区大小之间的权衡关系：更大的缓冲区能够减少选择噪声，并有望通过更准确的非参数估计解决平局问题，但代价是平滑效应增强以及策略更新速度变慢。

paragraphs.en: This subsection is a case study in extracting the maximum policy improvement that a selection operator and replay buffer allow. The mirror-descent update of Eq. ( 56 ) sets the learning rate and the KL weight exactly as derived through our theory, eliminating the need for tuning. At least this goes for FTW and DPO, GRPO in contrast cannot be instantiated as a graphical model and its centred-advantage loss admits no posterior precision update rule that yields a positive-definite covariance (Appendix F ). Thus, GRPO is run in three imperfect variants to approximate FTW’s and DPO’s learning rule, one version where normal GRPO is tuned for a learning rate, one where we assume that the covariance is learned through FTW’s update rule (ONG), and one where we use the local Fisher information as a gradient preconditioner (NPG). The environment is the linear contextual bandit of Appendix G.4 , rewards are deterministic and bounded, every arm has the same marginal 𝔼 x ​ [ r ​ ( x , a ) ] = 1 / 2 \mathbb{E}_{x}[r(x,a)]=\nicefrac{{1}}{{2}} , so all uncertainty is epistemic and positional structure needs to be exploited for low regret.
paragraphs.zh: 本小节是一个案例研究，旨在探讨选择算子和重播缓冲区所能实现的最大策略改进。公式（56）中的镜像下降更新将学习率和KL权重完全按照我们的理论推导结果进行设置，从而无需调参。至少对于FTW和DPO而言是如此；相比之下，GRPO无法被实例化为一个图模型，且其中心化优势损失不存在能产生正定协方差的后验精度更新规则（附录F）。因此，我们通过三种不完美的变体来运行GRPO，以近似FTW和DPO的学习规则：一种是对常规GRPO进行调参以优化学习率；另一种是假设协方差通过FTW的更新规则进行学习（ONG）；最后一种则是将局部费希尔信息用作梯度预条件子（NPG）。实验环境为附录G.4中的线性上下文多臂老虎机，奖励是确定且有界的，每个臂的边缘期望值均为 𝔼 x ​ [ r ​ ( x , a ) ] = 1 / 2 \mathbb{E}_{x}[r(x,a)]=\nicefrac{{1}}{{2}}，因此所有不确定性均为认识论不确定性，必须利用位置结构来降低遗憾。

paragraphs.en: The reason why we structured the learning rule and policy for this case study in this particular way is because the explicit Gaussian belief and the bootstrapping from the replay buffer form an analogous stand-in to how data is generated and resampled in typical LLM post-training. The LLM predictive (policy) behaves like an amortized posterior predictive that inserts its samples into the buffer. Resampling from that buffer exposes implicitly what the model does and does not know, at least structurally. This case-study then tests: given an agent whose uncertainty is represented explicitly and changing over time, does elite filtering act on that uncertainty and reduce it over time? An affirmative answer would hint at the idea that our framework and instantiation through FTW induces knowledge-seeking in LLM post-training. This question is also different to plain in-context learning, as data shouldn’t only reduce posterior uncertainty, they should also concentrate on the optimal policy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们之所以以这种特定方式构建本案例研究的学习规则和策略，是因为显式的高斯信念以及从重播缓冲区进行的自举，共同构成了一个与典型 LLM 后训练阶段中数据生成和重新采样过程相类似的替代机制。 LLM 的预测（策略）行为类似于一种摊销的后验预测分布，它会将自身的样本插入到缓冲区中。 从该缓冲区进行重新采样，能够隐式地揭示模型至少在结构上已知和未知的内容。 因此，本案例研究旨在检验：对于一个不确定性被显式表示且随时间变化的智能体，精英过滤是否会对这种不确定性产生作用，并使其随时间逐渐降低？ 如果答案是肯定的，这将暗示我们的框架以及通过 FTW 实现的实例化能够在 LLM 后训练阶段引发知识寻求行为。 这个问题也与单纯的情境内学习有所不同，因为数据不仅应能减少后验不确定性，还应促使模型聚焦于最优策略。

paragraphs.en: One somewhat obvious finding is that too little selection pressure never concentrates the policy, and too much prematurely converges on early winners before the belief has identified them, so regret decreases faster for intermediate selection pressure under each methodology (Figure 12 , top row). The effect is of similar size for FTW and DPO, roughly a fourfold spread in final simple regret across their knobs (Figure 12 , top row). In general, FTW and DPO are statistically indistinguishable at their best parameter-configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 一个较为明显的发现是，选择压力过小永远无法集中策略，而选择压力过大则会在信念尚未识别出早期获胜者之前，就过早地收敛于这些获胜者；因此，在每种方法中，中等强度的选择压力都能使遗憾值下降得更快（图 12，最上面一行）。 对于 FTW 和 DPO 而言，这种影响的大小相似，其最终简单遗憾值在其参数调节范围内大致存在四倍的差异（图 12，最上面一行）。 总体而言，在最佳参数配置下，FTW 和 DPO 在统计上无法区分。

paragraphs.en: What is also interesting is how the belief precision differs between FTW and DPO, despite achieving similar regret. The posterior width for FTW decreases more sharply than for DPO, and its predictive entropy ends lower as well (right of Figure 11 ). At equal regret, DPO thus retains a wider belief and a more diffuse predictive than FTW. GRPO’s belief metrics are either stale or overcontract due to the model misspecification or mismatch that prevents implementing a proper update rule in our framework.
paragraphs.zh: 同样有趣的是，尽管 FTW 和 DPO 实现了相似的遗憾值，但它们的信念精度却有所不同。 FTW 的后验宽度下降得比 DPO 更陡峭，其预测熵最终也更低（见图 11 右侧）。 因此，在相同遗憾值下，DPO 相比 FTW 保留了更宽的信念和更分散的预测分布。 由于模型规格错误或匹配不当导致无法在我们的框架中实施适当的更新规则，GRPO 的信念指标要么过时，要么过度收缩。

paragraphs.en: Plain GRPO converges prematurely at every fixed step size, whereas the Fisher preconditioner of GRPO-NPG removes most of this gap in both simple and cumulative regret (Figure 11 ). The misspecified FTW precision update used by GRPO-ONG contracts the belief before the mean has moved, so its policy stays near uniform and it achieves the worst regret of all tested methods aside from the uniform upper bound. Finally, the buffer-depth ladder (Figure 12 , bottom row) shows FTW insensitive to h h over three orders of magnitude, whereas DPO degrades sharply at h = 1024 h=1024 and GRPO is flat at its higher regret level.
paragraphs.zh: 普通的 GRPO 在每一步固定步长下都会过早收敛，而 GRPO-NPG 的 Fisher 预条件子则在简单后悔和累积后悔方面几乎消除了这一差距（图 11）。 GRPO-ONG 使用的错误指定的 FTW 精度更新会在均值移动之前收缩信念，因此其策略始终接近均匀分布，在所有测试的方法中（除均匀上界外），它的后悔值最差。 最后，缓冲区深度阶梯图（图 12，最底行）显示，FTW 对 h 在三个数量级范围内的变化不敏感，而 DPO 在 h = 1024 时性能急剧下降，GRPO 则在其较高的后悔水平上保持平稳。
